playlists.title: Mahabharatam — Every Episode in Order
playlists.description: The whole series, from Sauti's arrival at Naimisha to the end, in story order.

playlists.title: Season 1 · Adi Parva — The Beginning
playlists.description: The frame and the foundations. Sauti brings the epic to the sages of Naimisha; a dog's curse and a student's grudge lead King Janamejaya to a sacrifice that would burn every serpent, and the story of why the serpents were doomed (Kadru, Vinata, Garuda, the churning of the ocean) is told before the sage-boy Astika stops it. Then Vaishampayana begins the story proper: the Kuru line from Shakuntala and Yayati to Shantanu, Bhishma's vow, the births of the Pandavas and Kauravas, the house of lac, Draupadi's svayamvara, Indraprastha and the burning of the Khandava forest.

playlists.title: Season 2 · Sabha Parva — The Hall and the Dice
playlists.description: Maya builds the Pandavas a marvellous hall; Yudhishthira performs the royal consecration after Jarasandha is killed and the four brothers conquer the four directions; Krishna kills Shishupala. Humiliated in the hall, Duryodhana has Shakuni win everything from Yudhishthira at dice, including Draupadi, who is dragged into the assembly. A second game sends the Pandavas into thirteen years of exile.

playlists.title: Season 3 · Aranyaka (Vana) Parva — The Forest Years
playlists.description: Twelve years in the forest, the richest season for stories. Arjuna wins the Pashupata from Shiva and weapons in Indra's heaven; the brothers make a pilgrimage across India while sages tell them tales (Nala and Damayanti, Agastya, the descent of the Ganga, Rishyashringa, Savitri, Rama). Bhima meets Hanuman; Jayadratha abducts Draupadi; Indra takes Karna's armour; the Yaksha questions Yudhishthira.

playlists.title: Season 4 · Virata Parva — In Disguise
playlists.description: The thirteenth year, in hiding at King Virata's court in Matsya: Yudhishthira as a dice-playing courtier, Bhima as a cook, Arjuna as the dance teacher Brihannala, the twins as horse- and cowherd, Draupadi as a maid. Bhima kills Kichaka; the Kauravas raid Matsya's cattle, and Arjuna, with Prince Uttara as charioteer, routs them all.

playlists.title: Season 5 · Udyoga Parva — The Road to War
playlists.description: The effort for peace and the preparations for war. Arjuna chooses Krishna, Duryodhana his army; embassies go back and forth; Vidura counsels the sleepless king; Krishna himself goes to Hastinapura and shows his cosmic form; Kunti and Krishna each tell Karna the truth of his birth. Bhishma tells why he will not fight Shikhandin: the story of Amba.

playlists.title: Season 6 · Bhishma Parva — The Song and the Fall
playlists.description: Vyasa gives Sanjaya divine sight to report the war. On the first day Arjuna's despair draws out the Bhagavad Gita. Ten days of battle under Bhishma, until Bhishma tells the Pandavas how he can be defeated and falls on a bed of arrows behind Shikhandin.

playlists.title: Season 7 · Drona Parva — The Teacher's War
playlists.description: Drona commands the Kauravas for five days. Abhimanyu breaks into the wheel formation and is killed; Arjuna vows to kill Jayadratha by sunset or burn himself; Karna spends Indra's spear on Ghatotkacha; Drona lays down his arms when told "Ashvatthama is dead", and Ashvatthama unleashes the Narayana weapon.

playlists.title: Season 8 · Karna Parva — Karna
playlists.description: Karna commands for two days, with Shalya as his reluctant charioteer. Bhima drinks Duhshasana's blood; Yudhishthira insults Arjuna and Arjuna nearly kills him; and Karna, his chariot wheel stuck in the earth and his weapons forgotten, is killed by Arjuna.

playlists.title: Season 9 · Shalya Parva — The Last Day
playlists.description: The eighteenth day: Shalya commands and is killed by Yudhishthira; Sahadeva kills Shakuni; Duryodhana hides in a lake. Balarama, back from pilgrimage (whose tirthas are told as side tales), watches Bhima break Duryodhana's thigh with a foul blow.

playlists.title: Season 10 · Sauptika Parva — The Night Raid
playlists.description: Ashvatthama, Kripa and Kritavarman attack the sleeping Pandava camp: Dhrishtadyumna, Shikhandin and Draupadi's sons are killed. The Pandavas pursue Ashvatthama; his Brahmashira and Arjuna's meet, he turns his against the wombs of the Pandava women, and Krishna curses him.

playlists.title: Season 11 · Stri Parva — The Women's Lament
playlists.description: Grief after the war. Vidura consoles Dhritarashtra; the blind king crushes an iron Bhima; Gandhari's gaze burns Yudhishthira's toenail; on the battlefield Gandhari laments the dead and curses Krishna and his clan; the funeral rites, and Kunti's revelation that Karna was her son.

playlists.title: Season 12 · Shanti Parva — The Bed of Arrows
playlists.description: Yudhishthira wants to renounce the throne; his brothers, Draupadi and the sages argue him into ruling; Narada tells Karna's story. Then, by Krishna's arrangement, Bhishma on his bed of arrows teaches the duties of kings, conduct in disaster, and the way to liberation: the largest wisdom season.

playlists.title: Season 13 · Anushasana Parva — The Last Teachings
playlists.description: Bhishma's teachings continue: on gifts, fasting, cows, the dead, and the thousand names of Vishnu, with many tales. At the sun's northward turn, Bhishma gives up his life.

playlists.title: Season 14 · Ashvamedhika Parva — The Horse Sacrifice
playlists.description: To atone, Yudhishthira performs the horse sacrifice with King Marutta's buried gold. Krishna gives Arjuna the Anugita, meets the sage Uttanka, and revives Uttaraa's stillborn son Parikshit. Arjuna follows the horse for a year and is killed and revived by his son Babhruvahana. A golden mongoose belittles the whole sacrifice.

playlists.title: Season 15 · Ashramavasika Parva — The Forest Hermitage
playlists.description: After fifteen years, Dhritarashtra, Gandhari, Kunti, Vidura and Sanjaya retire to the forest. Vidura dies into Yudhishthira; Vyasa calls up the dead from the Ganga for one night; Dhritarashtra, Gandhari and Kunti die in a forest fire.

playlists.title: Season 16 · Mausala Parva — The Iron Club
playlists.description: Thirty-six years after the war, Gandhari's curse is fulfilled: the Vrishnis, drunk at Prabhasa, kill one another with reeds that turn to iron clubs. Balarama leaves his body; Krishna is shot by a hunter; Arjuna leads the survivors away and the sea swallows Dvaraka.

playlists.title: Season 17 · Mahaprasthanika Parva — The Great Journey
playlists.description: The Pandavas crown Parikshit and set out with Draupadi and a dog toward the north. One by one they fall on the way, each for a fault Yudhishthira names; only he and the dog reach Indra's chariot, and he refuses to go to heaven without the dog.

playlists.title: Season 18 · Svargarohana Parva — The Ascent
playlists.description: In heaven Yudhishthira finds Duryodhana enthroned and his brothers apparently in hell; he chooses to stay with them; the illusion fades. All take their divine places. The frame closes: Janamejaya's sacrifice ends, and Sauti finishes his story to the sages of Naimisha.

playlists.title: The Storyteller and the Curse · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: Sauti arrives at Naimisha and names the battlefield and the armies; Vyasa composes the epic; then the first threads of the frame: Sarama's curse on Janamejaya and Uttanka's quarrel with Takshaka, which ends in the king's vow.

playlists.title: The Serpents' Doom · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: How Takshaka killed Parikshit, how Janamejaya's sacrifice began, and the first answer to "why?": two sisters, one husband, and a curse that one mother laid on her own children.

playlists.title: The Churning of the Ocean · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: The story within the story: gods and asuras churn the ocean with Mount Mandara and the serpent Vasuki; the moon, Shri, the white horse and the amrita rise; the poison is held; Narayana takes the amrita from the asuras in the form of an enchanting woman; Rahu is beheaded; and the war over the amrita is won.

playlists.title: Garuda · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: Kadru wins the wager by cheating and curses the serpents who refuse to help her; Vinata becomes a slave; her second son Garuda hatches blazing like fire, and to free his mother he storms heaven, takes the amrita, wins Vishnu's friendship and Indra's, and leaves the serpents with forked tongues.

playlists.title: Astika · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: The serpents try to escape their mother's curse: Shesha leaves to hold up the earth, Vasuki holds council and learns of a boy who will save them. The ascetic Jaratkaru marries Vasuki's sister for his ancestors' sake, and their son Astika walks into Janamejaya's sacrifice and stops it.

playlists.title: Tales of the Bhrigus · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: Shaunaka, a descendant of Bhrigu, hears his own family's stories: Bhrigu's wife Puloma and the demon, the child Chyavana who burned him, Agni cursed to eat everything, and Ruru, who gave half his life for his bride and hated snakes until a snake taught him mercy.

playlists.title: Vyasa Begins · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: Vyasa comes to Janamejaya's sacrifice and has Vaishampayana tell the story. A one-breath summary of the whole epic; the origin of Satyavati and of Vyasa himself; and why gods and demons were born as men.

playlists.title: Shakuntala · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: King Dushyanta meets Shakuntala, the daughter of Vishvamitra and Menaka, in Kanva's hermitage, marries her in secret, and later denies her at court; her great speech and a voice from the sky make him acknowledge their son Bharata, from whom the Bharatas take their name.

playlists.title: Yayati · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: Kacha learns the secret of reviving the dead from the asuras' guru Shukra and refuses Shukra's daughter Devayani; Devayani and the asura princess Sharmishtha quarrel; King Yayati marries one and secretly loves the other, is cursed with old age, borrows his youngest son Puru's youth, learns that desire is never satisfied, falls from heaven and is raised again by his grandsons.

playlists.title: Ganga's Sons · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: The Puru line down to Shantanu. A king cursed for staring at Ganga, eight gods cursed for stealing a cow, a river goddess who drowns her sons, and the eighth son, Devavrata, who gives up the throne and marriage for his father's happiness and becomes Bhishma.

playlists.title: The Empty Throne · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: Shantanu's sons by Satyavati die young and childless; Bhishma takes the three princesses of Kashi and lets Amba go; Satyavati calls her first son Vyasa, who fathers Dhritarashtra, Pandu and Vidura; Vidura's birth is explained by a sage wrongly impaled.

playlists.title: Sons of the Gods · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: Kunti's mantra and Karna's secret birth; Pandu's marriages, his curse and retreat to the forest; the births of the five Pandavas by gods and of Gandhari's hundred sons from a lump of flesh; Pandu's death and the return to Hastinapura.

playlists.title: The Princes' School · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: Duryodhana poisons Bhima, who returns stronger from the Naga world; the teachers Kripa and Drona arrive, Drona carrying a grudge against Drupada; Ekalavya's thumb, the bird's eye, the tournament where Karna challenges Arjuna and is crowned king of Anga, and Drona's fee.

playlists.title: The House of Lac · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: Yudhishthira is made heir; Duryodhana persuades his father to send the Pandavas to Varanavata, where a house of lac is built to burn them; Vidura's coded warning, a secret tunnel and a night of fire.

playlists.title: Hidimba and Baka · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: In the forest, Bhima kills the rakshasa Hidimba and marries his sister Hidimbi, who bears Ghatotkacha; Vyasa sends the Pandavas, disguised as brahmins, to Ekachakra, where Bhima kills the man-eater Baka for their host's family.

playlists.title: The Gandharva's Tales · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: The Pandavas hear how Draupadi and Dhrishtadyumna were born from Drupada's fire and why Draupadi will have five husbands; on the way to Panchala Arjuna defeats the Gandharva Angaraparna, who tells them stories of the sages of old: Tapati and Samvarana, Vasishtha and Vishvamitra, Kalmashapada, Parashara and Aurva.

playlists.title: Draupadi's Svayamvara · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: Arjuna, disguised as a brahmin, strings the great bow and hits the target to win Draupadi; the kings attack; Kunti's unthinking "share it equally" leads to Draupadi marrying all five brothers, which Vyasa justifies with the tale of the five Indras. Krishna meets the Pandavas for the first time.

playlists.title: Indraprastha · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: Hastinapura learns the Pandavas are alive; Duryodhana and Karna argue for treachery or war, Bhishma, Drona and Vidura for sharing the kingdom; the Pandavas return and are given the wilderness of Khandavaprastha, where they build Indraprastha. Narada warns them, with the tale of Sunda and Upasunda, not to quarrel over Draupadi.

playlists.title: Arjuna's Exile and Subhadra · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: Arjuna breaks the rule to save a brahmin's cows and goes into exile: the Naga princess Ulupi, Chitrangada of Manipura, five cursed apsaras freed, and Krishna at Prabhasa; at Dvaraka he carries off Krishna's sister Subhadra with Krishna's blessing. Abhimanyu and Draupadi's sons are born.

playlists.title: The Burning of Khandava · Mahabharatam S1
playlists.description: Agni, sick and hungry, asks Krishna and Arjuna to let him consume the Khandava forest, which Indra protects for Takshaka; he arms them with the Gandiva bow and the Sudarshana discus. They hold off Indra and every creature while the forest burns. Only Takshaka's son, the asura Maya and four young birds escape. Season finale.

playlists.title: The Hall of Maya · Mahabharatam S2
playlists.description: Maya repays his debt with a hall of illusions for Yudhishthira, and fetches Bhima's mace and Arjuna's conch Devadatta from Lake Bindusaras. Narada visits and describes the halls of Indra, Yama, Varuna, Kubera and Brahma, and brings a message from Pandu in Yama's hall: perform the Rajasuya.

playlists.title: Narada's Questions · Mahabharatam S2
playlists.description: Narada visits the new hall and questions Yudhishthira on every duty of a king ("Do you…?"): the kaccit chapter, a complete handbook of governance in questions.

playlists.title: Jarasandha · Mahabharatam S2
playlists.description: Krishna explains that Jarasandha of Magadha, who holds eighty-six kings captive for sacrifice, must fall first; the story of his birth in two halves joined by the rakshasi Jara; Krishna, Bhima and Arjuna enter Girivraja disguised as snataka brahmins; Bhima wrestles Jarasandha for thirteen days and tears him in two.

playlists.title: Conquering the Four Directions · Mahabharatam S2
playlists.description: Arjuna goes north, Bhima east, Sahadeva south and Nakula west, gathering tribute for the Rajasuya; set pieces include Arjuna among the northern peoples and Sahadeva's embassy as far as Lanka.

playlists.title: The Royal Consecration and Shishupala · Mahabharatam S2
playlists.description: The Rajasuya; Bhishma proposes that the first honour go to Krishna; Shishupala of Chedi insults Krishna, Bhishma and the assembly; Bhishma tells of Shishupala's birth and the promise to forgive a hundred offences; Krishna's discus ends it.

playlists.title: Duryodhana in the Hall · Mahabharatam S2
playlists.description: Duryodhana stays on in the hall, mistakes crystal for water and water for crystal, and is laughed at; his envy at the Pandavas' wealth; Shakuni proposes the game of dice and they persuade Dhritarashtra over Vidura's warnings.

playlists.title: The Game of Dice · Mahabharatam S2
playlists.description: Vidura brings the invitation; Yudhishthira cannot refuse a challenge; Shakuni plays for Duryodhana and wins the treasury, the kingdom, the brothers, Yudhishthira himself and Draupadi. Duhshasana drags Draupadi into the assembly; her question (did he lose himself before he staked me?) goes unanswered by the elders; Vikarna alone speaks; Karna calls her a whore; as Duhshasana pulls at her garment, garment after garment appears; Bhima's vows; jackals howl and Dhritarashtra grants Draupadi boons that free her husbands.

playlists.title: The Second Game · Mahabharatam S2
playlists.description: Duryodhana persuades his father to recall the Pandavas for one more throw: the loser goes to the forest for twelve years and a thirteenth in hiding. They lose. The Pandavas leave, each in his own manner, and Draupadi with her hair unbound; Vidura reads the omens; Kunti stays with Vidura.

playlists.title: Into the Forest · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: The citizens follow the Pandavas; Yudhishthira praises the Sun and receives a vessel that feeds all their guests; Vidura, banished for his counsel, joins them and is recalled; Vyasa and Maitreya warn Dhritarashtra, and Maitreya curses Duryodhana to have his thigh broken. On the way to the Kamyaka forest, the rakshasa Kirmira, Baka's brother, bars the path; Bhima kills him.

playlists.title: Krishna in the Forest and the Fall of Saubha · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Krishna visits and Draupadi pours out her grief and anger; Krishna explains he was away fighting Shalva and his flying city Saubha, and tells that war.

playlists.title: Anger and Forgiveness · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: The great forest debates: Draupadi and Bhima argue that a king must act and fight; Yudhishthira defends forbearance and keeping his word. Bali and Prahlada on forgiveness; fate against human effort. Vyasa teaches Yudhishthira the Pratismriti spell for Arjuna.

playlists.title: The Hunter and the Bow · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Arjuna goes alone to the Himalaya to win divine weapons; Indra in disguise tests him; after fierce austerities he fights a mountain hunter over a boar, cannot defeat him, and recognises Shiva, who gives him the Pashupata; the world-guardians give their weapons.

playlists.title: Arjuna in Indra's Heaven · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Matali's chariot carries Arjuna to Amaravati; he learns weapons and music and dance from the Gandharva Chitrasena; Lomasha brings news of him to the brothers.

playlists.title: Nala and Damayanti · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Told by the sage Brihadashva to a grieving Yudhishthira: the swan messenger; Damayanti chooses Nala over four gods at her svayamvara; Kali possesses Nala, who loses everything at dice and abandons her in the forest; the serpent Karkotaka's bite disguises him as a charioteer; Damayanti's search and second svayamvara; the knowledge of dice and horses exchanged with King Rituparna; recognition and restoration.

playlists.title: The Pilgrimage Begins · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Narada and Pulastya describe the holy places; the sage Lomasha arrives from heaven and leads the brothers on a pilgrimage across India.

playlists.title: Agastya · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Tales told along the way: Agastya and Lopamudra; the demons Vatapi and Ilvala (Agastya digests Vatapi); Agastya stops the Vindhya mountain from growing and drinks the ocean so the gods can kill the Kalakeyas hiding in it.

playlists.title: The Descent of the Ganga · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: King Sagara's sixty thousand sons dig up the earth looking for the sacrificial horse and are burned by Kapila's gaze; generations later Bhagiratha's austerities bring the Ganga down from heaven, and Shiva bears her fall on his head.

playlists.title: Rishyashringa · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: The deer-horned boy raised in the forest who has never seen a woman; a courtesan is sent to lure him to drought-struck Anga, and the rain follows him.

playlists.title: Parashurama's Story · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: The birth of Parashurama; his father Jamadagni orders him to kill his mother Renuka and he obeys, then asks for her life back; King Kartavirya steals Jamadagni's calf, Parashurama kills him, Kartavirya's sons kill Jamadagni, and Parashurama rids the earth of kshatriyas twenty-one times.

playlists.title: Kings and Sages of Old · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Princess Sukanya pokes the eyes of the old sage Chyavana, buried in an anthill, and marries him in atonement; the Ashvins make him young and he wins them a share of the soma, paralysing Indra's arm. Mandhata, born from his father's side; Somaka and his one son Jantu; Shibi, who gives his own flesh to save a dove from a hawk (Indra and Agni testing him).

playlists.title: Ashtavakra and Yavakri · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: The boy cursed in the womb by his father to be bent in eight places defeats the court debater Bandin at King Janaka's court and frees his drowned father. Yavakri wins the Vedas by austerity instead of study, insults Raibhya, and dies by the demon Raibhya creates; Paravasu kills his father by mistake.

playlists.title: The Flower and the Monkey · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Into the high Himalaya; Draupadi wants the saugandhika flower; Bhima's path is blocked by an old monkey who is his brother Hanuman, son of Vayu, who shows his giant form and teaches him the ages and the duties; Bhima fights the Yakshas at Kubera's lake; the rakshasa Jatasura carries off Yudhishthira, the twins and Draupadi and is killed.

playlists.title: Arjuna Returns · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: The brothers reach Mount Gandhamadana; Arjuna returns in Indra's chariot and tells of destroying the Nivatakavachas under the sea and the flying city of the Paulomas and Kalakeyas.

playlists.title: The Python · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: A huge python seizes Bhima. It is King Nahusha, cursed by Agastya; Yudhishthira answers his questions on who is a brahmin, truth and conduct, and frees both.

playlists.title: Markandeya: the End of the World · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: The ageless sage Markandeya tells of the ages and the dissolution: alone in the cosmic flood he finds a child on a banyan branch and enters his body to see all the worlds within. Also: Vaivasvata Manu and the fish that grows.

playlists.title: Markandeya's Kings · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: More of Markandeya's stories: King Parikshit of Ayodhya and the frog princess; Vamadeva's horses; Indradyumna, fallen from heaven because no one remembered him, and the creatures old enough to remember; Dhundhumara, the king who killed the demon Dhundhu under the sands.

playlists.title: The Faithful Wife and the Butcher · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: The proud ascetic Kaushika burns a crane with a look and is put in his place by a housewife, who sends him to a butcher in Mithila; the dharmavyadha teaches him that duty done well is holiness. Satyabhama asks Draupadi how she keeps five husbands devoted; Draupadi's answer.

playlists.title: The Birth of Skanda · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: The birth of Skanda, the war-god, from Agni and Svaha, who took the forms of the sages' wives (the epic also calls him Rudra's son); the Krittikas; his consecration as general of the gods.

playlists.title: The Cattle Expedition · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Duryodhana goes to gloat over the exiles under cover of counting cattle; the Gandharvas capture him; Arjuna and Bhima free him at Yudhishthira's order; humiliated, Duryodhana resolves to fast to death and is roused by the danavas; Karna conquers the world for him and he performs the Vaishnava sacrifice.

playlists.title: Durvasa and Mudgala · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Duryodhana sends the irascible Durvasa and his ten thousand disciples to the Pandavas after their meal; Krishna eats the last leaf in Draupadi's pot and the sages feel full (as tradition tells it). A deer's dream moves the brothers to another forest; Vyasa tells of the sage Mudgala, who lives on a measure of gleaned grain, feeds Durvasa without anger, and declines heaven when he learns its limits.

playlists.title: Draupadi Abducted · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Jayadratha of Sindhu, Duryodhana's brother-in-law, finds Draupadi alone and carries her off; the Pandavas pursue, Bhima shaves his head into five tufts, and Yudhishthira spares him for Duhshala's sake. Jayadratha wins a boon from Shiva: to hold back four Pandavas for a day.

playlists.title: The Story of Rama · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Markandeya consoles Yudhishthira with the story of Rama: Ravana's origin, Rama's exile, Sita's abduction, Hanuman, the bridge, the war, the fire ordeal, the return. The epic's own short Ramayana.

playlists.title: Savitri · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Princess Savitri chooses Satyavan, who is fated to die within a year; on the day, she follows Yama as he carries Satyavan's life away, and with her wisdom wins boons until he must give it back.

playlists.title: Karna's Armour · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: Surya warns Karna in a dream that Indra will come begging for his armour and earrings; Karna will not refuse a request; he cuts them from his body and receives Indra's spear, good for one kill. Kunti's story of his birth is told again.

playlists.title: The Yaksha's Questions · Mahabharatam S3
playlists.description: A brahmin's fire-sticks are carried off by a deer; chasing it, the brothers find a lake guarded by a voice; four drink without answering and fall dead; Yudhishthira answers the Yaksha's riddles ("what is the greatest wonder?"), chooses Nakula's life, and the Yaksha reveals himself as Dharma. The thirteenth year begins.

playlists.title: Into Disguise · Mahabharatam S4
playlists.description: Choosing disguises; Dhaumya's counsel on serving a king; the weapons hidden in a shami tree; arriving at Virata's court; Bhima wrestles for the king.

playlists.title: Kichaka · Mahabharatam S4
playlists.description: The queen's brother, Kichaka, the army commander, lusts after the maid Sairandhri (Draupadi) and kicks her in front of the king; Bhima, waiting in the dark dance hall where Kichaka expects Sairandhri, crushes him to a ball; Kichaka's brothers are killed too.

playlists.title: The Cattle Raid · Mahabharatam S4
playlists.description: Trigartas and Kauravas raid Matsya's cattle; Prince Uttara boasts, panics and flees; Brihannala reveals himself as Arjuna, takes the Gandiva from the shami tree and defeats Karna, Drona, Kripa, Ashvatthama, Bhishma and Duryodhana, stunning them all with a weapon and taking their clothes. Was the year over? Bhishma's reckoning.

playlists.title: Revealed · Mahabharatam S4
playlists.description: Virata strikes Yudhishthira with a die for praising Brihannala over Uttara; the Pandavas reveal themselves; Arjuna declines Princess Uttaraa as his own bride and accepts her for his son Abhimanyu.

playlists.title: Choosing Sides · Mahabharatam S5
playlists.description: At Virata's court the allies plan; Arjuna and Duryodhana come to Krishna at the same time: one may have Krishna unarmed, the other his army, and Arjuna chooses Krishna. Shalya, the twins' uncle, is tricked by Duryodhana's hospitality into fighting for the Kauravas, and promises Yudhishthira to undermine Karna.

playlists.title: Indra, Vritra and Nahusha · Mahabharatam S5
playlists.description: Shalya consoles Yudhishthira with Indra's own fall: Indra kills Trishiras and Vritra and must hide; Nahusha becomes Indra and lusts after Shachi; the sages carry his palanquin until Agastya curses him to become a serpent.

playlists.title: Sanjaya's Embassy · Mahabharatam S5
playlists.description: Drupada's priest goes to Hastinapura; Sanjaya comes to the Pandavas with soft words and no offer; Yudhishthira asks only five villages.

playlists.title: Vidura's Counsel · Mahabharatam S5
playlists.description: The sleepless king calls Vidura in the night: Vidura's great teaching on the wise and the foolish, kingship, speech, anger and greed (Vidura Niti).

playlists.title: The Eternal Youth · Mahabharatam S5
playlists.description: The ancient sage Sanatsujata teaches Dhritarashtra about death, which is heedlessness, and about Brahman (the Sanatsujatiya).

playlists.title: The Councils · Mahabharatam S5
playlists.description: Sanjaya reports in the Kuru assembly; Bhishma, Drona and Dhritarashtra warn Duryodhana, who boasts; Karna and Bhishma quarrel; Sanjaya describes Krishna's greatness.

playlists.title: Krishna's Peace Mission · Mahabharatam S5
playlists.description: Krishna goes to Hastinapura as envoy; he stays with Vidura; Draupadi shows him her unbound hair; in the assembly sages and elders plead, Duryodhana refuses even a needle's point of land and plans to seize Krishna, who shows his universal form and walks out.

playlists.title: Tales Told in the Assembly · Mahabharatam S5
playlists.description: Stories told to soften Duryodhana: Dambhodbhava, the king who challenged Nara and Narayana; Matali, Indra's charioteer, searching the worlds for a husband for his daughter; Galava, who must find eight hundred white horses with one black ear for his teacher's fee, and Yayati's daughter Madhavi, given to four kings in turn.

playlists.title: Kunti's Message and Karna's Choice · Mahabharatam S5
playlists.description: Kunti's message to her sons: the story of Vidula, the queen who roused her defeated son to fight. Krishna tells Karna he is Kunti's firstborn and offers him the kingdom and Draupadi; Karna refuses for Duryodhana's sake and Radha's; Kunti comes to him at the river; he promises to spare four of her sons: she will always have five.

playlists.title: The Armies March · Mahabharatam S5
playlists.description: The Pandavas choose Dhrishtadyumna as commander and the Kauravas Bhishma; Balarama goes on pilgrimage rather than fight; Rukmi is refused; Uluka carries Duryodhana's taunts; Bhishma counts the great chariot-warriors and slights Karna, who vows not to fight while Bhishma lives.

playlists.title: Amba · Mahabharatam S5
playlists.description: Bhishma explains why he will not fight Shikhandin: Amba, rejected by Shalva, sought revenge; Parashurama fought Bhishma for her for twenty-three days and could not win; she burned herself to be reborn as Drupada's child, Shikhandin, who exchanged sex with a Yaksha.

playlists.title: Before the Battle · Mahabharatam S6
playlists.description: The rules of war agreed; Vyasa offers Dhritarashtra sight and gives Sanjaya divine vision instead; omens; Sanjaya describes the earth and its continents (summarised).

playlists.title: The Bhagavad Gita I: Despair and the Self (chapters 1–6) · Mahabharatam S6
playlists.description: Arjuna sees his kin and teachers and lays down his bow; Krishna teaches the undying self, action without attachment to its fruits, knowledge, renunciation and meditation. Three Shorts per chapter.

playlists.title: The Bhagavad Gita II: The Vision (chapters 7–12) · Mahabharatam S6
playlists.description: Knowledge and realisation, the imperishable, the royal secret, the divine glories, the universal form that Arjuna begs to see and fears, and devotion.

playlists.title: The Bhagavad Gita III: The Field and the Choice (chapters 13–18) · Mahabharatam S6
playlists.description: The field and its knower, the three gunas, the cosmic tree, the divine and demonic natures, the three kinds of faith, and liberation: "Do as you choose." Arjuna takes up his bow.

playlists.title: Days One to Three · Mahabharatam S6
playlists.description: Yudhishthira walks unarmed to the enemy to ask his elders' blessing; the first clash and Uttara's brother Shveta killed; Bhishma's mastery; on the third day Krishna, angered by Arjuna's mildness, leaps down with his discus to kill Bhishma (the chariot wheel is a later retelling's image), and Arjuna holds him back.

playlists.title: Days Four to Six · Mahabharatam S6
playlists.description: Bhima's rampage among Dhritarashtra's sons; Ghatotkacha; the formations (makara, krauncha, shyena); Duryodhana's complaints to Bhishma.

playlists.title: Days Seven to Nine · Mahabharatam S6
playlists.description: Iravat, Arjuna's son by Ulupi, is killed; Bhima kills more of the Kauravas; on the ninth day Krishna again rises against Bhishma; that night the Pandavas go to Bhishma's tent and he tells them how he may be brought down.

playlists.title: The Fall of Bhishma · Mahabharatam S6
playlists.description: The tenth day: Arjuna shoots from behind Shikhandin; Bhishma, pierced all over, falls and lies on a bed of arrows, waiting for the sun's northern course; Arjuna gives him a pillow of arrows and draws water from the earth; Karna comes to him at night.

playlists.title: Drona Takes Command · Mahabharatam S7
playlists.description: Karna enters the battle; Drona is made commander and promises to capture Yudhishthira alive if Arjuna can be drawn away.

playlists.title: The Oath-Bound and Bhagadatta · Mahabharatam S7
playlists.description: The Samshaptakas swear to kill Arjuna or die and lure him away; the old king Bhagadatta on his elephant Supratika and the Vaishnava weapon Krishna takes on his own chest.

playlists.title: Abhimanyu · Mahabharatam S7
playlists.description: With Arjuna away, the sixteen-year-old Abhimanyu breaks into Drona's wheel formation; Jayadratha, using Shiva's boon, holds the other Pandavas at the gap; Abhimanyu fights six great warriors at once and is killed fighting with a chariot wheel. Vyasa consoles Yudhishthira with the story of the goddess of Death, who wept at her task, and Narada's tale of the sixteen great kings who died (the Shodasharajika).

playlists.title: Arjuna's Vow · Mahabharatam S7
playlists.description: Arjuna learns how his son died and vows to kill Jayadratha before sunset or enter the fire; Jayadratha wants to flee and is kept with promises of protection; Krishna and Arjuna's night journey, in a dream, to Shiva to renew the Pashupata; Subhadra's grief.

playlists.title: Satyaki and Bhima Break Through · Mahabharatam S7
playlists.description: The fourteenth day: Arjuna cuts through Drona's formations toward Jayadratha; his horses tire and Krishna waters them on the battlefield; Yudhishthira sends Satyaki and then Bhima after him; Bhima spares Karna's life and Karna spares Bhima's; Bhurishravas is about to kill Satyaki when Arjuna cuts off his arm, and Satyaki beheads him at prayer.

playlists.title: Jayadratha · Mahabharatam S7
playlists.description: The race against the sun: six great warriors guard Jayadratha; as the sun sinks Arjuna reaches him, and his arrow carries Jayadratha's head into the lap of his father Vriddhakshatra, whose own curse then strikes him.

playlists.title: The Night Battle and Ghatotkacha · Mahabharatam S7
playlists.description: The war goes on into the night by torchlight; Ghatotkacha's illusions terrify the Kauravas until Karna must spend Indra's spear, saved for Arjuna, to kill him; Krishna rejoices.

playlists.title: Ashvatthama Is Dead · Mahabharatam S7
playlists.description: Drona is unstoppable; Krishna has Bhima kill an elephant named Ashvatthama; Yudhishthira, who never lies, says "Ashvatthama is dead" and mutters "the elephant"; his chariot touches the ground; Drona lays down his weapons and Dhrishtadyumna beheads him.

playlists.title: The Narayana Weapon · Mahabharatam S7
playlists.description: Ashvatthama, in grief and rage, looses the Narayana weapon; Krishna tells everyone to drop their arms and bow; Bhima resists and has to be dragged down. Vyasa tells Arjuna of the figure he saw going before him in battle: Shiva.

playlists.title: Karna Commands · Mahabharatam S8
playlists.description: Karna is made commander; he asks for Shalya as charioteer; Shalya agrees only on condition he may speak as he likes, and mocks him; Karna boasts and curses. Shalya taunts Karna with the fable of a crow, fattened on leftovers, who challenged the swans to a flight over the ocean.

playlists.title: The Sixteenth Day and the Seventeenth Morning · Mahabharatam S8
playlists.description: Karna defeats Yudhishthira, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva and spares them as he promised Kunti; Ashvatthama and Arjuna duel.

playlists.title: Arjuna's Dilemma · Mahabharatam S8
playlists.description: Wounded, Yudhishthira insults Arjuna's Gandiva; Arjuna has vowed to kill anyone who does; Krishna teaches the subtlety of truth with the hunter Balaka and the ascetic Kaushika, and Arjuna "kills" his brother with harsh words, then himself with self-praise.

playlists.title: Duhshasana's Blood · Mahabharatam S8
playlists.description: Bhima kills Duhshasana and drinks his blood, fulfilling the vow from the dice hall.

playlists.title: Karna and Arjuna · Mahabharatam S8
playlists.description: The great duel; the serpent Ashvasena in Karna's arrow, which Krishna dodges by pressing the chariot into the earth; the earth swallows Karna's wheel and he forgets the Brahmastra (Parashurama's and a brahmin's curses); he asks for fair play; Krishna reminds him of Draupadi and Abhimanyu; Arjuna's arrow.

playlists.title: Shalya Commands · Mahabharatam S9
playlists.description: Kripa urges peace; Shalya is made commander; Yudhishthira, the mildest of men, kills him with a spear.

playlists.title: Shakuni's End and the Lake · Mahabharatam S9
playlists.description: Sahadeva kills Shakuni, who began the dice; the Kaurava army is gone; Sanjaya is captured and spared. Duryodhana hides under the waters of a lake; hunters betray him; Yudhishthira offers him one duel with any of them, with any weapon, for the kingdom.

playlists.title: Balarama's Pilgrimage · Mahabharatam S9
playlists.description: Balarama arrives from his pilgrimage on the Sarasvati, and the tirthas are told: the Moon's curse and his twenty-seven wives, Trita in the well, Vasishtha and Vishvamitra at the river, the old maiden who married for one night, Kurukshetra ploughed by Kuru.

playlists.title: The Mace Duel · Mahabharatam S9
playlists.description: Bhima and Duryodhana fight with maces; Krishna reminds Arjuna of Bhima's vow, Arjuna slaps his thigh, and Bhima breaks Duryodhana's thighs; Balarama, outraged, threatens Bhima; Duryodhana, dying, accuses Krishna; flowers fall on him; Ashvatthama is made commander of three.

playlists.title: The Owl and the Crows · Mahabharatam S10
playlists.description: Ashvatthama watches an owl kill sleeping crows and decides; Kripa argues against it; Shiva, in a terrible form, guards the gate and then gives himself to Ashvatthama.

playlists.title: The Massacre · Mahabharatam S10
playlists.description: The night slaughter; Dhrishtadyumna kicked to death; the sons of Draupadi and Shikhandin killed; the three tell the dying Duryodhana, who dies content.

playlists.title: The Jewel on His Brow · Mahabharatam S10
playlists.description: Draupadi demands Ashvatthama's life; the pursuit; Ashvatthama's grass-blade Brahmashira and Arjuna's; Vyasa and Narada stand between them; Ashvatthama turns his weapon on the unborn, Krishna promises to revive Uttaraa's child and curses Ashvatthama to wander for three thousand years; Draupadi receives his jewel.

playlists.title: The Man in the Well and the Iron Bhima · Mahabharatam S11
playlists.description: Vidura consoles Dhritarashtra with the parable of a man hanging in a well over a serpent, licking honey while mice gnaw the root: the human condition. The Pandavas meet the old king; Krishna substitutes an iron statue, which Dhritarashtra crushes in his embrace; Gandhari, about to curse, is calmed by Vyasa.

playlists.title: Gandhari's Curse · Mahabharatam S11
playlists.description: Given sight to see the field, Gandhari walks among the dead and weeping widows, and curses Krishna: in thirty-six years his own clan will destroy itself and he will die alone in the forest. Krishna accepts. The cremations; at the river, Kunti tells her sons to offer water for Karna, her firstborn; Yudhishthira's grief.

playlists.title: The King Who Would Not Rule · Mahabharatam S12
playlists.description: Narada tells Karna's life: Parashurama's curse when the insect bored his thigh and he did not move, the brahmin's curse over the cow, Indra's request. Yudhishthira wants to go to the forest; Arjuna, Bhima, the twins, Draupadi, Vyasa and Krishna argue; he curses women never to keep a secret, and is crowned in Hastinapura. Krishna, in meditation, thinks of Bhishma; Bhishma's hymn to Krishna; they go to Kurukshetra, Krishna restores Bhishma's strength, and the teaching begins.

playlists.title: The Duties of Kings I: Why Kings Exist · Mahabharatam S12
playlists.description: Rajadharma begins: the origin of kingship (a world without a king, and Prithu), the king's protection and danda, the four orders and stages of life, a king's daily conduct.

playlists.title: The Duties of Kings II: War, Counsel and Mercy · Mahabharatam S12
playlists.description: Rajadharma continued: ministers and counsel, spies, treasury and taxes, alliances and war, the fortress, how a king treats the defeated.

playlists.title: Bhishma's Fables · Mahabharatam S12
playlists.description: The animal fables Bhishma uses to teach a king: the tiger and the virtuous jackal; the camel whose neck grew too long; the ocean and the rivers (the reed bends, the tree breaks); the hermit's dog who became a sharabha; Indra and Prahlada, and good conduct leaving a king.

playlists.title: Fables for Hard Times · Mahabharatam S12
playlists.description: Apaddharma's stories: the cat and the mouse who trust each other for one night, the three fish, Vishvamitra stealing dog meat from an outcaste in a famine, the faithful dove couple and the fowler.

playlists.title: Conduct in Disaster · Mahabharatam S12
playlists.description: Apaddharma: what is right when the normal rules break down; the king in distress; danda and its mysterious nature.

playlists.title: The Way to Freedom I: Detachment · Mahabharatam S12
playlists.description: Mokshadharma: Janaka's "Mithila burns, nothing of mine burns", Manki and his oxen, the brahmin Pingala, Bhrigu and Bharadvaja on creation, Jajali and the merchant Tuladhara.

playlists.title: The Way to Freedom II: Samkhya, Yoga and the Narayaniya · Mahabharatam S12
playlists.description: Mokshadharma continued: Samkhya and Yoga, Vasishtha and Karala-Janaka, Yajnavalkya, and the Narayaniya: Narada's journey to the white island to see Narayana.

playlists.title: Shuka · Mahabharatam S12
playlists.description: Vyasa's son Shuka, born from a fire-stick, learns from Janaka, renounces everything and rises into the sky; Vyasa's grief and the mountains' echo.

playlists.title: Tales of Gift and Fate · Mahabharatam S13
playlists.description: Gautami's son killed by a snake: the hunter, the snake, Death and Time argue who is to blame. Sudarshana who conquered death by hospitality, Vishvamitra's birth, the parrot that would not leave the dry tree, Bhangashvana who became a woman and preferred it, Ashtavakra and the North, Chyavana and Kushika.

playlists.title: Devotion and Duty · Mahabharatam S13
playlists.description: More tales from the Anushasana: Upamanyu's devotion to Shiva (told by Krishna); Vipula, who guards his teacher's wife Ruchi from Indra by entering her body; Nahusha and the sage Chyavana caught in a fisherman's net; King Nriga, a lizard in a well because of a cow given twice, freed by Krishna.

playlists.title: On Giving and the Thousand Names · Mahabharatam S13
playlists.description: Danadharma: what to give, to whom and how; gifts of food, land, cows and lamps; fasts and pilgrimages; rites for ancestors; conduct and its fruits. Asked whom to worship, Bhishma recites the thousand names of Vishnu (Vishnu Sahasranama).

playlists.title: Bhishma's Departure · Mahabharatam S13
playlists.description: The sun turns north; Bhishma blesses the Pandavas and Krishna, takes leave and gives up his breath by yoga; the funeral; Ganga rises from the river to mourn her son.

playlists.title: Marutta's Gold · Mahabharatam S14
playlists.description: Vyasa directs Yudhishthira to the gold left by King Marutta, whose priest Samvarta defied Brihaspati and Indra.

playlists.title: The Anugita · Mahabharatam S14
playlists.description: Arjuna has forgotten the Gita; Krishna teaches again through older dialogues (Kashyapa and the Siddha, the brahmin and his wife, the guru and the disciple).

playlists.title: Uttanka and the Child Revived · Mahabharatam S14
playlists.description: On his way home Krishna meets the sage Uttanka, who threatens to curse him for not preventing the war; Krishna shows his form; Uttanka's boon of water in the desert, offered by Indra in an outcaste's form. (Uttanka's earrings quest is told again with differences.) Uttaraa's son is born dead from Ashvatthama's weapon; Kunti, Subhadra and Draupadi beg Krishna; he revives the child: Parikshit, the future father of Janamejaya. The frame closes a loop.

playlists.title: The Horse's Journey · Mahabharatam S14
playlists.description: Arjuna follows the horse for a year: the Trigartas, Bhagadatta's son, Jayadratha's grandson; at Manipura his son Babhruvahana, goaded by Ulupi, fights and kills him; Ulupi revives him with a Naga jewel.

playlists.title: The Golden Mongoose · Mahabharatam S14
playlists.description: The horse sacrifice; a mongoose, half its body golden, rolls in the ground and says the sacrifice is worth less than one poor brahmin family's gift of their last barley flour to a guest.

playlists.title: The Elders Leave · Mahabharatam S15
playlists.description: Bhima's barbs; Dhritarashtra asks leave to go to the forest, with Gandhari; Kunti, to her sons' dismay, goes with them. The Pandavas visit the hermitage; Vidura, an ascetic skeleton, leans against a tree and passes his life into Yudhishthira.

playlists.title: The Night of the Dead and the Forest Fire · Mahabharatam S15
playlists.description: Vyasa calls the fallen warriors up from the Ganga for one night, free of enmity; the widows who wish it follow their husbands into the river. Narada brings news: Dhritarashtra, Gandhari and Kunti, unable to flee, died in a forest fire, sitting in meditation.

playlists.title: The Iron Club · Mahabharatam S16
playlists.description: Young Vrishnis dress Samba as a pregnant woman to mock visiting sages, who curse him to give birth to an iron club that will destroy the clan; it is ground to powder and thrown into the sea. The drunken quarrel at Prabhasa: Satyaki and Kritavarman, then everyone, killing with reeds that become clubs; Balarama leaves his body as a great serpent; Krishna, sitting in the forest, is shot in the foot by the hunter Jara. Arjuna comes, grieves and leads the women away; the sea floods Dvaraka; robbers attack and the Gandiva fails him; Vyasa tells him the time of the Pandavas is over.

playlists.title: The Last Journey · Mahabharatam S17
playlists.description: The Pandavas renounce; Agni asks for the Gandiva and it goes back to the sea; the walk around the world; Draupadi, Sahadeva, Nakula, Arjuna and Bhima fall; Indra comes for Yudhishthira and says the dog cannot come; Yudhishthira refuses, and the dog becomes Dharma.

playlists.title: Heaven, Hell and the End of the Story · Mahabharatam S18
playlists.description: Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana in heaven and is led to a dark hell where voices of his brothers and Karna call to him; he chooses to stay; it was an illusion, a last test; he bathes in the heavenly Ganga and leaves his human body. Each hero returns to the god or power he came from (Bhishma to the Vasus, Karna to the Sun, Draupadi as Shri). Vaishampayana ends; Janamejaya's sacrifice is completed; Sauti closes the story at Naimisha with what it means to hear it.

seasons.title: The Beginning
seasons.summary: The frame and the foundations. Sauti brings the epic to the sages of Naimisha; a dog's curse and a student's grudge lead King Janamejaya to a sacrifice that would burn every serpent, and the story of why the serpents were doomed (Kadru, Vinata, Garuda, the churning of the ocean) is told before the sage-boy Astika stops it. Then Vaishampayana begins the story proper: the Kuru line from Shakuntala and Yayati to Shantanu, Bhishma's vow, the births of the Pandavas and Kauravas, the house of lac, Draupadi's svayamvara, Indraprastha and the burning of the Khandava forest.
seasons.upaparvas_note: CE adhyaya ranges for the Adi Parva upa-parvas are from memory of the CE's division and may be off by one or two at the boundaries (notably Sambhava/Jatugrihadaha around 1.123–124); verify against the BORI volumes before printing them on screen.

arcs.title: The Storyteller and the Curse
arcs.synopsis: Sauti arrives at Naimisha and names the battlefield and the armies; Vyasa composes the epic; then the first threads of the frame: Sarama's curse on Janamejaya and Uttanka's quarrel with Takshaka, which ends in the king's vow.

compilation.title: The Storyteller and the Curse · The Complete Story

episodes.title: The Storyteller Arrives
episodes.synopsis: In the Naimisha forest, sages led by Shaunaka keep a twelve-year sacrifice. The bard Ugrashravas, called Sauti, son of Lomaharshana, arrives. They ask him for the story he heard at King Janamejaya's snake sacrifice: the Mahabharatam, composed by Vyasa.
episodes.cliffhanger: And Sauti began with a field of blood.

episodes.title: The Field of Five Lakes
episodes.synopsis: The sages ask where the great war was fought. Sauti tells of Samantapanchaka: Parashurama, in his anger, struck down the kshatriyas again and again and filled five lakes with their blood; his ancestors appeared, asked him to stop, and the land became holy. (The verse says "again and again"; "twenty-one times" is the count the epic gives elsewhere.)
episodes.cliffhanger: On that ground, ages later, eighteen armies would meet.

episodes.title: Eighteen Armies
episodes.synopsis: Asked what an akshauhini is, Sauti builds one from a single patti (one chariot, one elephant, three horses, five foot soldiers), tripling it seven times and multiplying by ten: 21,870 chariots, as many elephants, 65,610 horses and 109,350 foot soldiers. Eighteen such armies met at Samantapanchaka and fought for eighteen days.
episodes.cliffhanger: A war so vast needed a story just as vast. Who first composed it?

episodes.title: The Story Is Born
episodes.synopsis: Vyasa holds the whole epic in his mind. As tradition tells it, Ganesha agrees to be his scribe if Vyasa never stops dictating; Vyasa asks that he write nothing he does not understand, and composes more whenever Ganesha pauses; when his pen breaks, Ganesha breaks off his own tusk. Vyasa teaches the epic to Vaishampayana, who first recites it at Janamejaya's sacrifice.
episodes.cliffhanger: But why was that sacrifice held?
episodes.notes: The Ganesha-as-scribe passage is in the vulgate's Adi Parva 1 but relegated to the apparatus of the Critical Edition; marked on screen "As tradition tells it". Vyasa teaching Vaishampayana is CE 1.1.

episodes.title: The Curse of Sarama
episodes.synopsis: At Kurukshetra, Janamejaya and his brothers Shrutasena, Ugrasena and Bhimasena sit at a long sacrifice. A puppy, the son of the divine dog Sarama, comes near and is beaten though he did nothing wrong. Sarama comes to the king: because her son was beaten without fault, an unseen danger will fall on him. Alarmed, Janamejaya looks for a priest to undo the curse.
episodes.cliffhanger: Far away, a young student was about to face the serpent king.

episodes.title: The Stolen Earrings
episodes.synopsis: Uttanka, the student of Veda, asks his teacher's wife what gift to bring; she asks for the earrings of King Paushya's queen. The queen gives them and warns that Takshaka covets them. On the way back Takshaka, disguised as a beggar, snatches them and vanishes into the earth; Uttanka follows him into the Naga world and wins them back with fire and smoke. Still angry, he urges Janamejaya to avenge his father Parikshit, whom Takshaka killed.
episodes.cliffhanger: The king vowed a sacrifice to burn every serpent.
episodes.reorder_note: The king's formal vow of the sarpa-satra is told later, in the Astika parva (1.47); the episode compresses it into his answer to Uttanka.

arcs.title: The Serpents' Doom
arcs.synopsis: How Takshaka killed Parikshit, how Janamejaya's sacrifice began, and the first answer to "why?": two sisters, one husband, and a curse that one mother laid on her own children.
arcs.reorder_note: The CE tells the Astika parva as Sauti answers Shaunaka: Jaratkaru first (1.13), then Kadru and Vinata (1.14–30), then the serpents' council (1.31–35), and Parikshit's death only at 1.36–40. We open with Parikshit and the sacrifice (the consequences) and then go back to the causes, so the frame stays in one line of suspense.

compilation.title: The Serpents' Doom · The Complete Story

episodes.title: The Seven-Day Curse
episodes.synopsis: King Parikshit, hunting, follows a wounded deer and asks the sage Shamika, who is keeping a vow of silence, where it went. Met with silence, he drapes a dead snake over the sage's shoulders with his bow. Shamika's son Shringin curses him: within seven days Takshaka will burn him with his venom. Shamika grieves and sends a warning; the king shuts himself in a palace on a single pillar, guarded by healers and mantras. On the seventh day serpents come disguised as hermits, bearing fruit; in one fruit crawls a tiny copper insect, which becomes Takshaka and burns the king with his venom. (The healer Kashyapa, whom Takshaka turned back on the road, is told in episode 37.)
episodes.cliffhanger: His son would answer with fire.

episodes.title: The Snake Sacrifice
episodes.synopsis: Janamejaya, told how his father died, vows the sarpa-satra. As the ground is measured, a builder foretells that a brahmin will stop the rite before it ends; the king orders that no stranger be let in. Priests in black, their eyes red with smoke, call the serpents by name, and serpents of every size and colour, bound by the mantras, fall into the fire. Takshaka flees to Indra, king of the gods: "Stay with me, Takshaka. You are safe."
episodes.cliffhanger: Why were the serpents doomed? Because their own mother cursed them.
episodes.notes: The brief for this episode gives "≈ ch. 47–51"; the beginning of the satra and Takshaka's flight are 1.47–48, while Astika's arrival (1.49–51) is held back for the end of arc a05.

episodes.title: Two Wives, Two Wishes
episodes.synopsis: Long ago the sage Kashyapa granted boons to his wives Kadru and Vinata, daughters of Daksha. Kadru asked for a thousand serpent sons of equal splendour; Vinata asked for only two, but stronger and more glorious than all of Kadru's. Kadru laid a thousand eggs, Vinata two, and the eggs were kept warm in steaming jars for five hundred years.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kadru's eggs hatched. Vinata's did not. And she could not wait.

episodes.title: The Broken Egg
episodes.synopsis: Ashamed that her rival's sons were born, Vinata broke one of her eggs. Inside was a son whose upper body was formed and whose lower body was not: Aruna. Angry, he cursed her to be her rival's slave for five hundred years, unless his brother, left to hatch in his own time, set her free. Aruna rose into the sky to become the charioteer of the Sun: the red of dawn.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then the sisters saw a horse rise from the ocean, and made a wager.

episodes.title: The Horse from the Ocean
episodes.synopsis: Kadru and Vinata see Uchchaihshravas, the white king of horses, honoured by the gods. Where did he come from? Sauti answers with a story within the story: on Mount Meru the gods, longing for the amrita, the drink of immortality, asked how to win it, and Narayana told them: churn the ocean, gods and asuras together.
episodes.cliffhanger: To churn an ocean, they needed a mountain for a stick and a serpent for a rope.

arcs.title: The Churning of the Ocean
arcs.synopsis: The story within the story: gods and asuras churn the ocean with Mount Mandara and the serpent Vasuki; the moon, Shri, the white horse and the amrita rise; the poison is held; Narayana takes the amrita from the asuras in the form of an enchanting woman; Rahu is beheaded; and the war over the amrita is won.

compilation.title: The Churning of the Ocean · The Complete Story

episodes.title: A Mountain for a Churning Stick
episodes.synopsis: At Brahma's and Narayana's word, the serpent Ananta uproots Mount Mandara and the gods carry it to the ocean, which agrees to be churned if it gets a share of the amrita. The king of tortoises, Akupara, takes the mountain on his back; Vasuki becomes the rope.
episodes.cliffhanger: They began to churn, and the ocean began to burn.

episodes.title: What Rose from the Ocean
episodes.synopsis: Gods and asuras churn. Fire and smoke pour from Vasuki's mouths, the mountain's forests burn and Indra puts the fire out with rain; the juices of trees and herbs run into the sea and it turns to milk, then to ghee. Out come the Moon, Shri, the goddess of wine, the white horse and the Kaustubha jewel, and last Dhanvantari carrying the white pot of amrita.
episodes.cliffhanger: But something else rose too: a poison that could burn the worlds.
episodes.notes: The story (the sea turning to milk and ghee; the Moon, Shri, Sura Devi, the white horse, the Kaustubha, Dhanvantari with the white pot) follows the CE's 1.16. The cliffhanger's poison is later tradition (see S01E014) and is marked "As tradition tells it" on screen, so the episode carries tradition_note.

episodes.title: The Blue Throat

refs.label: Adi 1.16 (the poison is in the vulgate/Southern recension, not the CE text)

episodes.synopsis: As tradition tells it (in the Southern manuscripts and the vulgate, not in the Critical Edition's text): as the churning goes on, the kalakuta poison rises, its fumes engulfing the worlds. At Brahma's request Shiva takes the poison and holds it in his throat, and is called Nilakantha, the blue-throated. (The CE itself passes from Dhanvantari straight to the asuras' clamour for the amrita.)
episodes.cliffhanger: And the asuras, seeing the amrita, wanted it all.
episodes.notes: Checked: the kalakuta poison and Shiva holding it in his throat (Nilakantha) are NOT in the constituted text of the CE's Adi 1.16; the CE passes from Dhanvantari and the amrita to the asuras' clamour. The passage is found in Southern manuscripts and the vulgate (Ganguli's Adi 18) and was relegated by Sukthankar as an interpolation; it is fully developed in the Puranas. The episode keeps it, marked "As tradition tells it" on screen.

episodes.title: The Enchantress and Rahu
episodes.synopsis: The asuras clamour for the amrita. Narayana takes on the illusion of a wondrous woman and takes the pot from them; the gods drink. The asura Rahu, disguised as a god, drinks too, but the Sun and the Moon point him out, and Narayana's discus cuts off his head while the amrita is still in his throat. The immortal head roars into the sky: the eternal enmity of Rahu with the Sun and Moon.
episodes.cliffhanger: The asuras saw they had been tricked. War broke out on the shore.
episodes.notes: The epic describes Narayana's form only as an enchanting woman; the name "Mohini" comes from the Puranas, so the title avoids it.

episodes.title: The War for the Amrita
episodes.synopsis: Gods and asuras fight on the shore. Nara with his bow and Narayana with the discus Sudarshana drive the asuras into the earth and the sea; Mandara is set back in its place, and the gods keep the amrita safe.
episodes.cliffhanger: Back on the shore, Kadru and Vinata looked at the white horse. "What colour is his tail?"

arcs.title: Garuda
arcs.synopsis: Kadru wins the wager by cheating and curses the serpents who refuse to help her; Vinata becomes a slave; her second son Garuda hatches blazing like fire, and to free his mother he storms heaven, takes the amrita, wins Vishnu's friendship and Indra's, and leaves the serpents with forked tongues.

compilation.title: Garuda · The Complete Story

episodes.title: The Wager
episodes.synopsis: Vinata says the horse is all white; Kadru says its tail is black; the loser will be the winner's slave. That night Kadru orders her thousand sons to hang from the tail as black hairs. Those who refuse she curses: they will burn in Janamejaya's snake sacrifice. Brahma lets the curse stand, because the serpents have grown too many and too venomous, and gives Kashyapa the knowledge that cures poison.
episodes.cliffhanger: At dawn the sisters flew out over the ocean to look.

episodes.title: The Black Hairs
episodes.synopsis: The sisters fly over the great ocean, its depths full of monsters and jewels, to where the horse stands. Its tail is streaked with black. Vinata, defeated, becomes Kadru's slave.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then the second egg cracked open, and the sky caught fire.

episodes.title: Garuda Is Born
episodes.synopsis: In his time Garuda bursts from his egg, huge and blazing, and rises into the sky. The gods, thinking he is Agni come to burn the worlds, beg for shelter and praise him; he hears their praise and draws in his radiance. He flies to his mother, and learns that she is a slave.
episodes.cliffhanger: And his first task as a slave's son: to carry the serpents.

episodes.title: Carrying the Serpents
episodes.synopsis: Kadru orders Vinata to carry her to an island in the sea, and Garuda to carry the serpents. He flies so close to the Sun that the serpents faint in the heat; Kadru prays to Indra, who sends rain. They come to the island of Ramaniyaka, and still the serpents order him about.
episodes.cliffhanger: Garuda asked them: "What will buy our freedom?"

episodes.title: The Price of Freedom
episodes.synopsis: The serpents name their price: bring us the amrita. Garuda asks his mother what he may eat on the way; she tells him to eat the Nishadas who live in a bay of the ocean, but never to harm a brahmin, who would burn in his throat like fire.
episodes.cliffhanger: He swooped down on the Nishadas, and swallowed something that burned.

episodes.title: The Brahmin in the Throat
episodes.synopsis: Garuda swallows a crowd of Nishadas, and one of them burns his throat: a brahmin. He offers to let him go, but the brahmin will not leave without his Nishada wife; Garuda releases them both. He then meets his father Kashyapa, who tells him what he may eat instead.
episodes.cliffhanger: Two brothers, cursed into an elephant and a tortoise, were fighting in a lake.

episodes.title: The Elephant and the Tortoise
episodes.synopsis: Kashyapa tells of two brothers, Vibhavasu and Supratika, who quarrelled over their inheritance and cursed each other to become an elephant and a tortoise; they fight on in a lake. Garuda seizes one in each claw and looks for a tree that will bear his weight. He lands on a giant branch, and it breaks.
episodes.cliffhanger: Hanging from that branch, upside down, were thousands of tiny sages.

episodes.title: The Thumb-Sized Sages
episodes.synopsis: The broken branch is full of Valakhilyas, sages no bigger than a thumb, hanging upside down in austerity. Garuda catches the branch in his beak so as not to kill them and flies on, not knowing where to put it down. Kashyapa begs the sages to let go; they leave for the Himalaya, and Garuda drops the branch on an empty mountain and eats his meal.
episodes.cliffhanger: Why did the Valakhilyas matter so much? Because they had once frightened Indra.

episodes.title: Why Indra Feared a Bird
episodes.synopsis: Shaunaka asks, and Sauti tells: at Kashyapa's sacrifice, Indra laughed at the Valakhilyas struggling to carry a single leaf. Insulted, they performed a rite to create another Indra. Kashyapa made peace: the new Indra would be the Indra of birds. That son was Garuda, born to Vinata.
episodes.cliffhanger: And now that bird was flying toward heaven.
episodes.notes: A digression in the CE itself (Shaunaka asks, Sauti answers), kept in its place.

episodes.title: Garuda Storms Heaven
episodes.synopsis: Heaven fills with omens: winds, meteors, blood rain. The gods arm themselves around the amrita. Garuda arrives, scatters the guards with dust from his wings, wounds the gods with beak and talons, and they flee in every direction.
episodes.cliffhanger: But the amrita was ringed with fire and a wheel of blades.

episodes.title: The Wheel of Blades
episodes.synopsis: Garuda drinks rivers to put out the fire around the amrita, shrinks small enough to slip through the spokes of a spinning wheel edged with blades, and blinds the two great serpents that guard it. He takes the amrita without drinking a drop.
episodes.cliffhanger: On his way out, he met Vishnu.

episodes.title: A Boon from Vishnu
episodes.synopsis: Pleased that Garuda did not drink, Vishnu offers him a boon. Garuda asks to stand above Vishnu, and to be immortal without the amrita. Vishnu grants both and asks a boon in return: be my mount. So Garuda carries Vishnu, and sits above him on his banner.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then Indra hurled his thunderbolt.

episodes.title: The Feather and the Thunderbolt
episodes.synopsis: Indra strikes with the vajra. Garuda is not hurt, but drops a single feather out of respect for the sage from whose bones the vajra was made. The gods name him Suparna, "fine-feathered". Indra offers friendship; Garuda accepts, and asks that the serpents be his food.
episodes.cliffhanger: Garuda flew down with the amrita. Indra followed, unseen.

episodes.title: Forked Tongues
episodes.synopsis: Garuda sets the amrita on a bed of kusha grass and tells the serpents to bathe before they drink. While they bathe, Indra takes it back to heaven. Vinata is free. The serpents lick the grass where the pot stood, and their tongues split in two; the kusha grass becomes holy.
episodes.cliffhanger: The serpents were cheated twice over. And the curse still stood.

arcs.title: Astika
arcs.synopsis: The serpents try to escape their mother's curse: Shesha leaves to hold up the earth, Vasuki holds council and learns of a boy who will save them. The ascetic Jaratkaru marries Vasuki's sister for his ancestors' sake, and their son Astika walks into Janamejaya's sacrifice and stops it.
arcs.reorder_note: The Jaratkaru story is told twice in the CE (briefly at 1.13, in full at 1.41–44); we tell it once, in full. The Parikshit material at 1.36–40 was used in episode 7; the CE's account of how Janamejaya learned the truth (1.45–46) closes the flashback here.

compilation.title: Astika · The Complete Story

episodes.title: Shesha Holds the Earth
episodes.synopsis: Shesha, the eldest serpent, will not live among his scheming brothers. He goes off to practise austerities at holy places until he is skin and bone. Brahma, pleased, asks him to lie beneath the earth and hold it steady, and gives him Garuda as a friend.
episodes.cliffhanger: Vasuki, his brother, chose a different path: he called a council.

episodes.title: Vasuki's Council
episodes.synopsis: Vasuki gathers the serpents to escape the curse. Some want to become brahmins and beg the king to stop; some, to bite the priests; some, to put out the fire as clouds. Then Elapatra speaks: he heard Brahma say that the sage Jaratkaru will marry a girl of the same name, Vasuki's sister, and their son Astika will save the good serpents.
episodes.cliffhanger: So the serpents watched for Jaratkaru, a sage who never wanted a wife.

episodes.title: The Ancestors in the Pit
episodes.synopsis: The ascetic Jaratkaru, wandering and celibate, finds his ancestors hanging head-down in a pit, clinging to a single stalk that a rat is gnawing away. If he has no son, they will fall. He agrees to marry, on conditions: the bride must have his own name, must be given freely, and he will not have to keep her.
episodes.cliffhanger: And one family had been waiting for him: the serpents.

episodes.title: The Bride with His Name
episodes.synopsis: Jaratkaru calls into the forest for a bride. Vasuki brings his sister, also named Jaratkaru, and promises to keep her. The sage adds one more condition: if she ever displeases him, he will leave.
episodes.cliffhanger: One evening, the sun began to set while he slept.

episodes.title: The Sunset Prayer
episodes.synopsis: Jaratkaru sleeps as the sun goes down. His wife must choose: let him miss his evening rite, or wake him and risk his anger. She wakes him. Insulted, he leaves her. As he goes she asks about the child; he answers "asti" ("there is"), and the child is named Astika.
episodes.cliffhanger: The boy grew up among the serpents, and the sacrifice drew near.

episodes.title: The Boy Called Astika
episodes.synopsis: Astika is born, raised in Vasuki's house and taught the Vedas by Chyavana, son of Bhrigu. The serpents watch him with hope: he is the one Brahma promised.
episodes.cliffhanger: Meanwhile, in Hastinapura, a king was asking how his father died.

episodes.title: The Witness in the Tree
episodes.synopsis: Janamejaya asks his ministers how Parikshit died. They tell him what one man saw: hidden in a banyan, he watched Takshaka bite the tree to ash and the healer Kashyapa bring it back to life, and Takshaka buy the healer off. The king learns that his father could have been saved, and his grief turns to fury.
episodes.cliffhanger: Back in the present: the fire was burning, and Vasuki was burning in it.
episodes.reorder_note: The witness account belongs to the ministers' report before the vow (1.45–46); we place it here as the last piece of the flashback, which returns to the sacrifice already under way (episode 8).

episodes.title: Astika at the Gate
episodes.synopsis: With most of his people burned and the spell dragging him toward the fire, Vasuki begs his sister to send her son. Astika goes to the sacrifice. Stopped at the gate, he wins entry by praising the king, the priests and the fire in verse.
episodes.cliffhanger: Delighted, the king offered him any boon. But first, the priests wanted Takshaka.

episodes.title: Indra Lets Go
episodes.synopsis: The priests say Takshaka is hiding with Indra. They call him by name with such force that Indra himself is dragged toward the fire with Takshaka in his garment, and Indra lets go and flees. As Takshaka falls toward the flames, Astika claims his boon: stop the sacrifice. When the king offers anything else, Astika calls "Stay!" three times, and Takshaka hangs in the air.
episodes.cliffhanger: Would the king keep his word?

episodes.title: The Sacrifice Stops
episodes.synopsis: The assembly urges the king, and Janamejaya grants the boon. The fire dies down, the builder's prophecy comes true, and the serpents, overjoyed, give Astika a boon in return: whoever recites this story will have nothing to fear from serpents. And in the pauses of that great sacrifice, the Mahabharata was told.
episodes.cliffhanger: But Sauti had another family to speak of: Shaunaka's own.

arcs.title: Tales of the Bhrigus
arcs.synopsis: Shaunaka, a descendant of Bhrigu, hears his own family's stories: Bhrigu's wife Puloma and the demon, the child Chyavana who burned him, Agni cursed to eat everything, and Ruru, who gave half his life for his bride and hated snakes until a snake taught him mercy.
arcs.reorder_note: In the CE the Pauloma parva (1.4–12) comes BEFORE the Astika parva. We move it after Astika, as a fireside interlude at Naimisha before Vaishampayana begins: its last tale, Ruru and the serpents, closes the serpent theme ("a man who hated snakes learns mercy") instead of interrupting it. An alternative is to air it as a standalone side arc between episodes 6 and 7.

compilation.title: Tales of the Bhrigus · The Complete Story

episodes.title: The Bride and the Demon
episodes.synopsis: Shaunaka asks Sauti for the story of his own ancestors, the Bhrigus. Bhrigu's pregnant wife Puloma is alone when the rakshasa Puloman, to whom she had once been promised, comes for her. He asks the household fire, Agni, whose wife she truly is; Agni, afraid of lying and afraid of the truth, admits she was first promised to the demon. The rakshasa takes the form of a boar and carries her off.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then the child in her womb fell to the ground, blazing.

episodes.title: The Child Who Fell
episodes.synopsis: The child slips from Puloma's womb (and is named Chyavana, "the fallen"), shining like the sun, and the rakshasa burns to ash. Puloma walks home weeping, and her tears become a river, the Vadhusara. Bhrigu learns that Agni betrayed her.
episodes.cliffhanger: And Bhrigu cursed the fire itself.

episodes.title: The Curse on Fire
episodes.synopsis: Bhrigu curses Agni to devour everything, pure and impure. Hurt (he had only told the truth), Agni withdraws from the world, and the sacrifices stop. Brahma resolves it: Agni will consume everything, and whatever he consumes will be made pure.
episodes.cliffhanger: Generations later, a descendant of Bhrigu lost his bride to a snake.

episodes.title: Ruru and Pramadvara
episodes.synopsis: Pramadvara, daughter of the apsara Menaka and the Gandharva king Vishvavasu, was left at the hermitage of the sage Sthulakesha and raised there. She is betrothed to Ruru, Chyavana's grandson. Days before the wedding she steps on a sleeping snake and dies of its bite.
episodes.cliffhanger: Ruru went into the forest to grieve, and a messenger of the gods answered him.

episodes.title: Half a Life
episodes.synopsis: Ruru, lamenting, offers whatever merit he has to bring her back. A messenger of the gods tells him there is one way: give her half of his own life. Ruru gives it; Dharma, lord of the dead, agrees, and Pramadvara wakes. They marry. But Ruru swears to kill every snake he meets.
episodes.cliffhanger: He raised his staff over a harmless snake. And the snake spoke.

episodes.title: The Snake Who Was a Sage
episodes.synopsis: The old dundubha snake Ruru is about to kill reveals he is the sage Sahasrapat, cursed by a friend he once frightened with a grass snake. Freed by meeting Ruru, he teaches that not harming living beings is a brahmin's highest duty, and tells him to learn how the serpents were saved at Janamejaya's sacrifice. Ruru's father Pramati tells him the story we have just heard.
episodes.cliffhanger: With the serpents saved, Vyasa rose to speak at Janamejaya's court.

arcs.title: Vyasa Begins
arcs.synopsis: Vyasa comes to Janamejaya's sacrifice and has Vaishampayana tell the story. A one-breath summary of the whole epic; the origin of Satyavati and of Vyasa himself; and why gods and demons were born as men.

compilation.title: Vyasa Begins · The Complete Story

episodes.title: Vyasa Comes to the Sacrifice
episodes.synopsis: Vyasa, the dark sage born on an island, arrives at Janamejaya's sacrifice with his disciples. The king honours him and asks how the quarrel between the Kurus and the Pandavas began. Vyasa turns to his disciple Vaishampayana: tell him everything, as you heard it from me.
episodes.cliffhanger: And Vaishampayana began by telling the whole story in one breath.

episodes.title: The Whole Story in One Breath
episodes.synopsis: Vaishampayana's summary of the epic: the cousins raised together, Duryodhana's envy, the poison and the house of lac, Draupadi won, the kingdom split, the game of dice, thirteen years of exile, the war, and the victory. The series' trailer, inside the story.
episodes.cliffhanger: To understand it, we must go back to a fish, a king and a ferry girl.

episodes.title: The King, the Fish and the Ferry Girl
episodes.synopsis: King Uparichara Vasu of Chedi, friend of Indra, rides a crystal chariot in the sky. Away hunting, he thinks of his wife and sends his seed to her by a hawk; it falls into the Yamuna and is swallowed by a fish, an apsara under a curse. The fishermen find twins inside her: a boy who becomes King Matsya, and a girl who smells of fish, raised by the fisher chief: Satyavati.
episodes.cliffhanger: She grew up rowing a ferry, until a great sage stepped into her boat.

episodes.title: Born on an Island
episodes.synopsis: The sage Parashara, crossing the Yamuna in Satyavati's boat, desires her. She sets conditions: a mist hides them, her virginity is restored, and her fish-smell turns to a fragrance carried for miles. Their son is born on an island in the river and grows up at once: Krishna Dvaipayana, Vyasa. He goes to the forest, promising to come whenever his mother thinks of him.
episodes.cliffhanger: That promise would one day save the Kuru line.

episodes.title: The Burden of the Earth
episodes.synopsis: After Parashurama's slaughter, the kshatriya line is reborn and the earth knows a golden age. Then the asuras, defeated in heaven, begin to be born on earth as proud kings and creatures, and the Earth, weighed down, goes to Brahma for help. He tells the gods to be born on earth in part to relieve her.
episodes.cliffhanger: So the gods came down, in disguise, as the heroes and villains of this story.

episodes.title: Gods in Disguise
episodes.synopsis: Vaishampayana names who was a portion of whom: Duryodhana of Kali, Karna of the Sun, Drona of Brihaspati, Bhishma of one of the Vasus, Vidura of Dharma, Krishna of Narayana, Balarama of Shesha, and many more, gods, asuras and rakshasas alike. The cast of the epic, revealed in advance.
episodes.cliffhanger: But first, the line those heroes were born into: it began in a hermitage.
episodes.reorder_note: The CE's creation genealogies (1.59–60) are summarised rather than dramatised.

arcs.title: Shakuntala
arcs.synopsis: King Dushyanta meets Shakuntala, the daughter of Vishvamitra and Menaka, in Kanva's hermitage, marries her in secret, and later denies her at court; her great speech and a voice from the sky make him acknowledge their son Bharata, from whom the Bharatas take their name.
arcs.tradition_note: The cursed ring, the sage Durvasa and the forgetting are from Kalidasa's play (Abhijnanashakuntalam), not the epic. In the Mahabharata Dushyanta remembers her perfectly and denies her for fear of what people will say. We tell the epic's version and say so on screen in episode 57.

compilation.title: Shakuntala · The Complete Story

episodes.title: The King and the Hermitage
episodes.synopsis: King Dushyanta of the Puru line, hunting with a great army, comes to a hermitage on the Malini river, full of birds, flowers and chanting. He leaves his men behind and goes in alone to pay his respects to the sage Kanva.
episodes.cliffhanger: The sage was away. A young woman came out to greet him.

episodes.title: The Girl the Birds Protected
episodes.synopsis: Shakuntala welcomes the king and tells him her origin as Kanva told it: Indra, frightened by Vishvamitra's austerities, sent the apsara Menaka to distract him; their daughter was left by the river, sheltered by birds (shakunta), and Kanva found her and named her Shakuntala.
episodes.cliffhanger: The king asked her to marry him, there and then.

episodes.title: A Marriage Without Witnesses
episodes.synopsis: Dushyanta proposes a Gandharva marriage, by mutual consent alone. Shakuntala agrees on one condition: her son will be his heir. He promises, marries her, and leaves, saying he will send an army to bring her to the city. Kanva returns and, knowing all by his insight, blesses her.
episodes.cliffhanger: Years passed. No army came.

episodes.title: The Boy Who Tamed Lions
episodes.synopsis: Shakuntala's son grows up in the hermitage. At six he catches lions, tigers and elephants and ties them to the trees, and the hermits name him Sarvadamana, "the tamer of all". Kanva decides it is time: he sends mother and son to the king.
episodes.cliffhanger: In the royal court, the king looked at her and said: I do not know you.
