episodes.title: "I Do Not Know You"
episodes.synopsis: Before the whole court Dushyanta denies her and insults her birth. Shakuntala answers with one of the great speeches of the epic: on truth, on a wife as half of a man, on a son as one's own self reborn. She turns to leave.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then a voice spoke from the sky.
episodes.notes: On screen: "In the epic, he does not forget her. (The ring and the curse come from Kalidasa's play.)"

episodes.title: The Voice from the Sky
episodes.synopsis: A voice from heaven declares: she speaks the truth, this is your son; support him (bhara). Dushyanta embraces them and admits he knew all along but needed the world to hear it. The boy is named Bharata and becomes a universal king, and from him the Bharatas, and the land, take their name.
episodes.cliffhanger: Generations before Bharata, his ancestor Yayati had paid a terrible price for desire.
episodes.reorder_note: Genealogically Yayati comes before Dushyanta; the CE also tells Shakuntala first (1.62–69) and then Yayati (1.70–88), so we follow its order.

arcs.title: Yayati
arcs.synopsis: Kacha learns the secret of reviving the dead from the asuras' guru Shukra and refuses Shukra's daughter Devayani; Devayani and the asura princess Sharmishtha quarrel; King Yayati marries one and secretly loves the other, is cursed with old age, borrows his youngest son Puru's youth, learns that desire is never satisfied, falls from heaven and is raised again by his grandsons.

compilation.title: Yayati · The Complete Story

episodes.title: The Secret of Reviving the Dead
episodes.synopsis: Gods and asuras are at war, and only the asuras' guru, Shukra, knows the sanjivani, the art of raising the dead. The gods send Kacha, son of their own guru Brihaspati, to become Shukra's student. He serves the teacher and charms his daughter, Devayani.
episodes.cliffhanger: The asuras saw through him, and killed him.

episodes.title: Kacha Dies Three Times
episodes.synopsis: The asuras kill Kacha twice; each time Devayani weeps and Shukra brings him back. The third time they burn him, grind his ashes into wine and serve it to Shukra. To save Kacha, Shukra must teach him the sanjivani inside his own belly; Kacha bursts out and revives his teacher. Shukra declares wine forbidden to brahmins.
episodes.cliffhanger: His studies over, Kacha came to say goodbye. Devayani had other plans.

episodes.title: The Curse at Parting
episodes.synopsis: Devayani asks Kacha to marry her. He refuses: she is his teacher's daughter, and he was reborn from her father's body. She curses him: his learning will not work for him. He curses her back: no sage's son will marry her. Kacha goes to heaven and teaches the gods.
episodes.cliffhanger: And Devayani's fate came to her at the edge of a well.

episodes.title: The Princess in the Well
episodes.synopsis: Devayani bathes with Sharmishtha, daughter of the asura king Vrishaparvan, and her friends. The wind mixes up their clothes; Sharmishtha puts on Devayani's, a quarrel flares about whose father serves whom, and Sharmishtha pushes Devayani into a dry well. King Yayati, out hunting, hears her and pulls her out by her right hand.
episodes.cliffhanger: Devayani would not go home until the princess paid.

episodes.title: A Princess Becomes a Servant
episodes.synopsis: Shukra counsels his daughter on forbearance, but she will not be calmed, so he threatens to leave the asuras. To keep their guru, Vrishaparvan agrees to anything; Devayani demands that Sharmishtha serve her, with a thousand maids. Sharmishtha agrees, to save her people.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then Yayati came back into the forest.

episodes.title: The Hand He Held
episodes.synopsis: Devayani meets Yayati again and claims him: he took her right hand, so he must marry her. He hesitates (a kshatriya marrying a brahmin's daughter is against custom), but Shukra gives his blessing, with one warning: never take Sharmishtha to your bed.
episodes.cliffhanger: Years later, Sharmishtha came to the king in the ashoka grove.

episodes.title: Sharmishtha's Secret
episodes.synopsis: Sharmishtha asks Yayati for a son, arguing that a king may not refuse what is asked of him; he yields. She bears three sons, Druhyu, Anu and Puru; Devayani bears Yadu and Turvasu. One day Devayani sees Sharmishtha's boys and asks who their father is. They point to the king.
episodes.cliffhanger: Devayani ran to her father. And Shukra cursed the king.

episodes.title: The Curse of Old Age
episodes.synopsis: Shukra curses Yayati with sudden old age. Yayati pleads that he has not had his fill of youth; Shukra relents that much: if a son will take the old age, the son may give him his youth.
episodes.cliffhanger: Yayati went to his sons, one by one.

episodes.title: The Son Who Gave His Youth
episodes.synopsis: Yadu, Turvasu, Druhyu and Anu refuse their father, and he curses each one's line. The youngest, Puru, says yes. Yayati becomes young; Puru grows old.
episodes.cliffhanger: A thousand years of pleasure later, Yayati learned something.

episodes.title: Desire Is Never Satisfied
episodes.synopsis: After a thousand years Yayati sees it: desire is never quenched by enjoyment; it grows like fire fed with ghee. He returns Puru's youth and, over the people's objection that Yadu is the eldest, makes Puru king, because Puru obeyed. From Puru come the Pauravas, the Kurus' line; from Yadu, the Yadavas, Krishna's.
episodes.cliffhanger: Yayati went to heaven. And from heaven, he fell.

episodes.title: The Fall from Heaven
episodes.synopsis: In heaven Indra asks Yayati whose austerities equal his. Yayati says no one's, not god, man or sage; for that boast his merit runs out and he falls. He asks to fall among good people, and drops toward a sacrifice performed by four kings.
episodes.cliffhanger: They were his own grandsons, though none of them knew it.

episodes.title: The Grandsons' Gift
episodes.synopsis: Ashtaka and his brothers Pratardana, Vasumat and Shibi question the falling king about the worlds after death and what leads to them. Each offers him his own merit; Yayati, a kshatriya, will not take gifts. They give it to him on the strength of truth instead, and five golden chariots carry all of them to heaven.
episodes.cliffhanger: From Puru's line, many generations later, came a king named Shantanu.
episodes.notes: The CE's Uttarayayata (1.81–88) is largely dialogue; condensed. Yayati's daughter Madhavi, the grandsons' mother, belongs to the Galava tale in the Udyoga Parva (S05).

arcs.title: Ganga's Sons
arcs.synopsis: The Puru line down to Shantanu. A king cursed for staring at Ganga, eight gods cursed for stealing a cow, a river goddess who drowns her sons, and the eighth son, Devavrata, who gives up the throne and marriage for his father's happiness and becomes Bhishma.

compilation.title: Ganga's Sons · The Complete Story

episodes.title: From Puru to Kuru
episodes.synopsis: The line from Puru: Dushyanta and Bharata; Hastin, who founded Hastinapura; Samvarana and Tapati's son Kuru, who gave his name to the Kurus and to Kurukshetra; down to King Pratipa. A family tree, told as a river.
episodes.cliffhanger: Up in Brahma's court, a king looked where he should not have.
episodes.notes: Genealogy episode: keep it visual (a living tree), keep the names few.

episodes.title: The King Who Stared
episodes.synopsis: King Mahabhisha has won heaven. In Brahma's court, a breeze lifts the river goddess Ganga's garment; the gods lower their eyes, but Mahabhisha stares. Brahma curses him to be born on earth. On her way down, Ganga meets the eight Vasus, also cursed to be born as men, who beg her to be their mother and drown them at birth, so that they are freed at once.
episodes.cliffhanger: What had the Vasus done? They had stolen a cow.

episodes.title: The Stolen Cow
episodes.synopsis: On the wife of Dyaus' urging, the eight Vasus steal Nandini, the wish-granting cow of the sage Vasishtha. Vasishtha curses them to be born as men. When they beg, he softens: seven will be freed within a year of birth, but Dyaus, who did the stealing, will live a long human life, have no children, and be famous for his virtue.
episodes.cliffhanger: And Ganga went to find a king to be their father.
episodes.reorder_note: In the CE Ganga tells Shantanu this story only after he stops her at the eighth son (1.93); we tell it first so the drowning is understood.

episodes.title: The Promise on the Riverbank
episodes.synopsis: Ganga sits on the right thigh of King Pratipa as he prays by the river; he says the right thigh is for a daughter or daughter-in-law, and promises her to his son. That son, Shantanu, meets her on the riverbank and asks her to marry him. She agrees on one condition: he must never question or stop anything she does.
episodes.cliffhanger: She bore a son. And she carried him to the river.

episodes.title: Seven Sons in the River
episodes.synopsis: One after another Ganga drowns seven newborn sons, smiling, and Shantanu, bound by his promise, says nothing. When she takes the eighth he cannot bear it and stops her. She reveals who she is and why, and leaves, taking the child with her.
episodes.cliffhanger: Years later, Shantanu found the river dammed by a boy's arrows.

episodes.title: The Boy Who Stopped the Ganga
episodes.synopsis: Shantanu finds the Ganga shrunk to a trickle and a radiant young man holding it back with a dam of arrows. Ganga appears and gives him his son Devavrata, taught the Vedas by Vasishtha and every weapon a king could need. Shantanu makes him heir to the throne.
episodes.cliffhanger: Four years later, Shantanu smelled a fragrance on the Yamuna, and fell in love.
episodes.notes: The CE here says Devavrata knows all weapons; that Parashurama was his teacher is stated in the Udyoga Parva (the Amba story).

episodes.title: The Fisherman's Condition
episodes.synopsis: Shantanu meets Satyavati, the fragrant ferry girl, and asks her father, the fisher chief, for her hand. The chief names his price: her son must be king. Shantanu cannot disinherit Devavrata, goes home and pines. Devavrata learns why.
episodes.cliffhanger: He went to the fisherman himself.

episodes.title: The Terrible Vow
episodes.synopsis: Devavrata gives up the throne. When the chief worries about Devavrata's future sons, he vows never to marry at all. Flowers fall from the sky and the gods call him Bhishma, "the one of the terrible vow". His grateful father grants him a boon: he will die only when he chooses.
episodes.cliffhanger: Bhishma had saved his father's love. Now he had to guard a throne that would never be his.

arcs.title: The Empty Throne
arcs.synopsis: Shantanu's sons by Satyavati die young and childless; Bhishma takes the three princesses of Kashi and lets Amba go; Satyavati calls her first son Vyasa, who fathers Dhritarashtra, Pandu and Vidura; Vidura's birth is explained by a sage wrongly impaled.

compilation.title: The Empty Throne · The Complete Story

episodes.title: The Gandharva's Challenge
episodes.synopsis: Shantanu dies. His son Chitrangada becomes king and is killed by a Gandharva of the same name after a three-year duel at Kurukshetra. The boy Vichitravirya is crowned, and Bhishma rules on his behalf.
episodes.cliffhanger: Vichitravirya needed a bride. Bhishma went to get three.

episodes.title: Three Princesses of Kashi
episodes.synopsis: At the svayamvara of the king of Kashi's three daughters, Amba, Ambika and Ambalika, Bhishma carries all three off in his chariot and defeats the kings who pursue him, among them Shalva. In Hastinapura Amba says she had chosen Shalva in her heart; Bhishma lets her go. Vichitravirya marries Ambika and Ambalika.
episodes.cliffhanger: Amba's story was not over. It would come back for Bhishma.
episodes.notes: Amba's fate (Shalva's rejection, Parashurama, Shikhandin) is told in the Udyoga Parva's Ambopakhyana: Season 5.

episodes.title: A Vow Against a Kingdom
episodes.synopsis: Vichitravirya dies of consumption after seven years, childless. Satyavati begs Bhishma to take the throne and father heirs with the widows. Bhishma refuses: he would give up the three worlds before he broke his word.
episodes.cliffhanger: But he knew of an old way out.

episodes.title: The Blind Sage's Sons
episodes.synopsis: Bhishma recalls precedents: after Parashurama's slaughter, kshatriya women bore sons by brahmins; and the blind sage Dirghatamas, cast adrift by his own sons, fathered heirs for King Bali's queen, the founders of Anga, Vanga and Kalinga. Let a worthy brahmin father a son.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then Satyavati told her secret.

episodes.title: The Son from the Island
episodes.synopsis: Satyavati tells Bhishma about Parashara and her firstborn, Vyasa, and calls him with a thought, as he promised. Vyasa comes, and agrees to father sons for his half-brother's widows, though he warns that his austerities have made him fearsome to look at.
episodes.cliffhanger: Ambika closed her eyes.

episodes.title: Eyes Closed, Face Pale
episodes.synopsis: Ambika, seeing Vyasa's dark, matted, fearsome form, shuts her eyes, and her son Dhritarashtra is born blind. Ambalika turns pale, and her son Pandu is born pale. Ambika sends her maid in her place; the maid is calm and respectful, and her son is Vidura, wisest of men.
episodes.cliffhanger: Vidura was Dharma himself, born as a man because of a curse.

episodes.title: The Sage on the Stake
episodes.synopsis: The sage Mandavya, silent in his vow, is impaled because thieves hid their loot near him. He survives on the stake and later asks Dharma what he did to deserve it. "As a child you pierced an insect with a blade of grass." Mandavya, now called Animandavya, curses Dharma to be born of a servant woman, and sets a new law: no sin counts before the age of fourteen.
episodes.cliffhanger: So Dharma was born as Vidura, and the three princes grew up together.

episodes.title: A Blindfold for Life
episodes.synopsis: Under Bhishma, Kurujangala prospers. Pandu becomes king, because the blind cannot rule. Bhishma seeks Gandhari, princess of Gandhara, for Dhritarashtra; learning that her husband is blind, she blindfolds herself for life. Her brother Shakuni brings her to Hastinapura.
episodes.cliffhanger: In another palace, a young princess was given a mantra.

arcs.title: Sons of the Gods
arcs.synopsis: Kunti's mantra and Karna's secret birth; Pandu's marriages, his curse and retreat to the forest; the births of the five Pandavas by gods and of Gandhari's hundred sons from a lump of flesh; Pandu's death and the return to Hastinapura.

compilation.title: Sons of the Gods · The Complete Story

episodes.title: The Mantra of Durvasa
episodes.synopsis: Pritha, daughter of Shura, is given to her childless cousin Kuntibhoja and called Kunti. She serves the irascible sage Durvasa so well that he gives her a mantra to call any god to give her a son. Young and curious, she tries it on the Sun.
episodes.cliffhanger: Surya came down from the sky, and would not leave empty-handed.

episodes.title: The Child in the Basket
episodes.synopsis: Surya gives Kunti a son born in armour and earrings, and restores her maidenhood. Afraid of what people will say, she sets the baby afloat in a basket on the river. The charioteer Adhiratha and his wife Radha find and raise him as Vasushena. Later he gives the armour away to Indra, and is called Karna.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kunti went on to choose a husband: King Pandu.

episodes.title: Kunti and Madri
episodes.synopsis: Kunti chooses Pandu at her svayamvara. Bhishma also wins Madri, sister of Shalya, for Pandu by paying her family the bride-price their custom requires. Pandu conquers the kingdoms around and brings their wealth home. Vidura marries too.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then Gandhari heard that Kunti had borne a son before her.

episodes.title: A Hundred Jars
episodes.synopsis: Gandhari, blessed by Vyasa with a hundred sons, is pregnant for two years. Hearing that Kunti has a son, she strikes her womb and delivers a hard lump of flesh. Vyasa has it divided into a hundred and one parts and kept in jars of ghee. Duryodhana is born first, and jackals howl; Vidura advises abandoning him, and Dhritarashtra refuses. The hundred sons and a daughter, Duhshala, are born; Yuyutsu is born to a maid.
episodes.cliffhanger: In the forest, Pandu drew his bow at two deer.
episodes.reorder_note: In the CE Gandhari's pregnancy (1.107) is told before Pandu's curse (1.109) but overlaps it in time: Yudhishthira is born before Duryodhana, and Bhima on Duryodhana's birthday (1.114).

episodes.title: The Deer Who Cursed a King
episodes.synopsis: Pandu, hunting, shoots a stag mating with a doe. The stag is the sage Kindama in deer form; dying, he curses Pandu: you too will die the moment you lie with a woman.
episodes.cliffhanger: A king who could never have sons gave up his crown.

episodes.title: The King Becomes a Hermit
episodes.synopsis: Pandu, shattered, renounces the kingdom and goes to live as an ascetic on Mount Shatashringa with Kunti and Madri. But the sages tell him the childless cannot reach heaven, and he grieves for the sons he cannot have.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then Kunti told him her secret: the mantra.

episodes.title: Kunti's Answer
episodes.synopsis: Pandu begs Kunti to have sons by a worthy man. She tells of Vyushitashva's widow, who bore sons by her dead husband; he answers with the old ways before Shvetaketu made marriage binding. Then she reveals Durvasa's mantra. Which god first? Dharma, says Pandu.
episodes.cliffhanger: And Dharma came.

episodes.title: Sons of the Gods
episodes.synopsis: From Dharma, Kunti bears Yudhishthira. From Vayu, Bhima, who falls from her lap as a baby and shatters a rock; he is born the same day as Duryodhana. From Indra, Arjuna, at whose birth a voice from the sky foretells his glory.
episodes.cliffhanger: Madri asked for a son too.

episodes.title: Madri's Twins
episodes.synopsis: Pandu asks Kunti to give Madri the mantra once. Madri calls the twin Ashvins and bears twins, Nakula and Sahadeva. When Pandu asks again, Kunti refuses: Madri used one call to get two sons and might outdo her.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then came spring, and Pandu forgot the curse.

episodes.title: Spring in the Forest
episodes.synopsis: In the spring forest, Pandu sees Madri in fine clothes and, overcome, takes her in his arms despite her pleas, and dies, as the sage foretold. Madri, blaming herself, follows him in death, leaving her sons to Kunti.
episodes.cliffhanger: The sages carried the five boys to Hastinapura.

episodes.title: The Return to Hastinapura
episodes.synopsis: The sages bring Kunti, the five boys and the bodies of Pandu and Madri to Hastinapura, and vouch for the children. After the funeral Vyasa warns his mother that hard times are coming; Satyavati, Ambika and Ambalika retire to the forest.
episodes.cliffhanger: At play, Bhima tormented his cousins, and Duryodhana began to plot.

arcs.title: The Princes' School
arcs.synopsis: Duryodhana poisons Bhima, who returns stronger from the Naga world; the teachers Kripa and Drona arrive, Drona carrying a grudge against Drupada; Ekalavya's thumb, the bird's eye, the tournament where Karna challenges Arjuna and is crowned king of Anga, and Drona's fee.

compilation.title: The Princes' School · The Complete Story

episodes.title: Bhima and the Poisoned Sweets
episodes.synopsis: Bhima, stronger than all his cousins, bullies them at play. At a water-palace at Pramanakoti on the Ganga, Duryodhana feeds him poisoned food, ties him with creepers and throws him into the river. He sinks to the Naga world, where serpent bites cancel the poison; the Naga Aryaka recognises him as kin, and Vasuki lets him drink the strengthening nectar. He sleeps eight days and comes home.
episodes.cliffhanger: The princes needed teachers. The first was born among reeds.

episodes.title: Born from Reeds
episodes.synopsis: The sage Sharadvat, master of archery, sees the apsara Janapadi; his seed falls on a clump of reeds and becomes twins. King Shantanu finds them and raises them out of compassion (kripa): Kripa and Kripi. Kripa becomes the princes' first teacher of arms.
episodes.cliffhanger: Their real teacher was born from a pot.

episodes.title: Drona and the Friend Who Forgot
episodes.synopsis: The sage Bharadvaja's seed, falling into a pot (drona), becomes Drona. He studies with Prince Drupada, who promises to share his kingdom. Drona marries Kripi and has a son, Ashvatthama, who neighs like a horse at birth. Poor, he receives weapons from Parashurama, and goes to Drupada, now king, and calls him friend. Drupada sneers: friendship is only between equals.
episodes.cliffhanger: Drona went to Hastinapura with a grudge, and found the princes staring into a well.

episodes.title: The Ball in the Well
episodes.synopsis: The princes' ball falls into a well. A lean brahmin pulls it out with a chain of grass blades, each piercing the one before, and his ring with an arrow. Bhishma recognises Drona and engages him as their teacher. Drona asks for one thing in return, later; only Arjuna promises.
episodes.cliffhanger: Arjuna practised even in the dark. Someone else practised alone.

episodes.title: Ekalavya's Thumb
episodes.synopsis: Arjuna learns to shoot in the dark. Ekalavya, a Nishada prince, is refused by Drona, makes a clay image of him and teaches himself. When the princes' dog barks at him, he seals its mouth with seven arrows. Drona, having promised Arjuna he would have no equal, asks for his fee: Ekalavya's right thumb. He gives it.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then Drona set his students a test: a bird in a tree.

episodes.title: The Bird's Eye
episodes.synopsis: Drona sets a wooden bird in a tree and asks each student what he sees. The tree, the sky, you, my brothers, they say, and he sends them away. Arjuna sees only the bird's head, and cuts it off. Later, when a crocodile seizes Drona in the Ganga, Arjuna frees him, and receives the Brahmashira weapon.
episodes.cliffhanger: Their training complete, the princes would show the world what they had learned.

episodes.title: The Tournament
episodes.synopsis: Drona holds a display of arms for the court and the city. The princes ride and shoot; Bhima and Duryodhana's mace bout turns into a real fight and has to be stopped. Then Arjuna shows weapon after divine weapon, and the crowd roars.
episodes.cliffhanger: At the gate, someone answered the crowd with the slap of his arms.

episodes.title: The Stranger in Armour
episodes.synopsis: Karna walks into the arena in his natural armour and earrings, repeats every feat of Arjuna's, and challenges him to a duel. Kunti recognises her son and faints. Kripa asks the stranger's lineage; Duryodhana answers by crowning Karna king of Anga on the spot. Karna asks what he can give; Duryodhana asks for his friendship forever.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then an old charioteer limped into the arena, and Karna bowed to him.

episodes.title: Son of a Charioteer
episodes.synopsis: Adhiratha enters and Karna bows to his father. Bhima mocks him: take up a whip, son of a charioteer. Duryodhana answers that the origins of heroes and rivers are not to be looked into, and leads Karna away as the sun sets.
episodes.cliffhanger: Drona asked for his fee at last: King Drupada, in chains.

episodes.title: The Teacher's Fee
episodes.synopsis: Drona's fee is Drupada. The Kauravas attack Panchala first and are driven back; the Pandavas capture Drupada and bring him in. Drona returns half his kingdom and keeps the northern half: now they are equals, he says, and can be friends. Drupada leaves seeking a son who will kill Drona.
episodes.cliffhanger: In Hastinapura, the people wanted Yudhishthira as their king, and Duryodhana could not bear it.

arcs.title: The House of Lac
arcs.synopsis: Yudhishthira is made heir; Duryodhana persuades his father to send the Pandavas to Varanavata, where a house of lac is built to burn them; Vidura's coded warning, a secret tunnel and a night of fire.
arcs.tradition_note: The "Kanika-niti" (the minister Kanika's counsel of ruthless statecraft to Dhritarashtra), familiar from the vulgate, is believed to be outside the CE's constituted text; if used later as a wisdom piece it should be marked "As tradition tells it".

compilation.title: The House of Lac · The Complete Story

episodes.title: The Heir and the Jealous Cousin
episodes.synopsis: Yudhishthira is made crown prince and the Pandavas' fame spreads. The citizens openly say he should be king. Duryodhana, burning with envy, goes to his father: let the Pandavas be sent away to Varanavata for a festival, and the throne will be ours.
episodes.cliffhanger: Dhritarashtra agreed. And Duryodhana sent for a builder.

episodes.title: A House Built to Burn
episodes.synopsis: The Pandavas and Kunti are sent to Varanavata. Duryodhana secretly orders his minister Purochana to build them a fine house of hemp, resin, lac and ghee, and to set it on fire when they least expect it.
episodes.cliffhanger: As they left, Vidura spoke to Yudhishthira in a language no one else understood.

episodes.title: Vidura's Riddle
episodes.synopsis: At the departure Vidura warns Yudhishthira in a foreign tongue and in riddles: a weapon not made of iron, a fire that does not burn the one who lives in a burrow. Yudhishthira answers, "I have understood."
episodes.cliffhanger: In Varanavata, the walls smelled of ghee.

episodes.title: The Tunnel
episodes.synopsis: Yudhishthira smells lac and ghee and understands. They decide to live there as if unaware. A miner sent by Vidura digs a tunnel from the house; for a year they hunt by day and sleep near the tunnel by night, watching Purochana.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then one night, Kunti gave a feast.

episodes.title: The Night of Fire
episodes.synopsis: Kunti feeds the brahmins of the town; a Nishada woman and her five sons drink and fall asleep in the house. At midnight Bhima sets the fire, starting at Purochana's door, and the six escape through the tunnel. Vidura's boatman ferries them across the Ganga. In the ashes the people find a woman and five young men, and Hastinapura mourns the Pandavas.
episodes.cliffhanger: Alive and hidden, they walked into the darkest forest of all.

episodes.title: Into the Dark Forest
episodes.synopsis: In Hastinapura Dhritarashtra and the Kauravas perform the funeral rites, while Bhishma and Vidura grieve (Vidura knowing the truth). In the forest Bhima carries his mother and brothers through the night, and as they sleep on the bare ground he grieves for them and swears to repay Duryodhana.
episodes.cliffhanger: From a tree nearby, a rakshasa smelled human flesh.

arcs.title: Hidimba and Baka
arcs.synopsis: In the forest, Bhima kills the rakshasa Hidimba and marries his sister Hidimbi, who bears Ghatotkacha; Vyasa sends the Pandavas, disguised as brahmins, to Ekachakra, where Bhima kills the man-eater Baka for their host's family.

compilation.title: Hidimba and Baka · The Complete Story

episodes.title: The Rakshasa's Sister
episodes.synopsis: The rakshasa Hidimba smells the Pandavas and sends his sister Hidimbi to kill them. She sees Bhima keeping watch, falls in love, takes a beautiful form and begs him to flee with her.
episodes.cliffhanger: Her brother came to see what was taking so long.

episodes.title: Bhima and Hidimba
episodes.synopsis: Hidimba, furious at his sister, charges; Bhima drags him away so the others can sleep, and they fight, uprooting trees. The others wake; Arjuna urges Bhima to finish it before dawn, and Bhima kills the rakshasa.
episodes.cliffhanger: Hidimbi fell at Kunti's feet: give me your son.

episodes.title: Ghatotkacha
episodes.synopsis: Hidimbi pleads with Kunti and Yudhishthira; they agree that she may be with Bhima by day until she has a son. Their son is born a rakshasa child and grows up within hours, bald as a pot: Ghatotkacha. He leaves, promising to come whenever his father needs him.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then their grandfather appeared out of the forest.

episodes.title: Vyasa's Counsel
episodes.synopsis: Vyasa appears to the Pandavas, comforts Kunti, and leads them to the town of Ekachakra, to live in a brahmin's house disguised as brahmins, begging for alms, until he returns.
episodes.cliffhanger: One day, in their host's house, everyone was weeping.

episodes.title: The Weeping House
episodes.synopsis: Kunti hears their brahmin host's family weeping. A rakshasa, Baka, rules the town: each household in turn must send him a cartload of food, two buffaloes and a person, and he eats them all. It is their turn. The father, the mother and the daughter each offer to go, and the little son picks up a stick and says he will kill the rakshasa.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kunti had a better idea. She had Bhima.

episodes.title: Kunti's Offer
episodes.synopsis: Kunti offers one of her own sons to go in place of the brahmin. The brahmin refuses to let a guest die for him; Kunti tells him her son is mighty. Yudhishthira is horrified that she would risk Bhima; Kunti explains that repaying their host is dharma, and that Bhima killed Hidimba.
episodes.cliffhanger: Bhima set off with the cart of food, and started eating it himself.

episodes.title: The Cart of Food
episodes.synopsis: At Baka's forest Bhima sits down and eats the rakshasa's food, calling him by name. Baka rushes up in rage; Bhima finishes eating, then fights him, uprooting trees, and breaks his back.
episodes.cliffhanger: Bhima dragged the body to the town gate, and kept the secret.

episodes.title: The Town Set Free
episodes.synopsis: The rakshasa's kin beg for mercy and promise never to harm humans again. Bhima leaves Baka's body at the gate; the townspeople are amazed, but the Pandavas let it be thought that some brahmin's magic did it.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then a travelling brahmin brought news: the princess of Panchala would choose a husband.

arcs.title: The Gandharva's Tales
arcs.synopsis: The Pandavas hear how Draupadi and Dhrishtadyumna were born from Drupada's fire and why Draupadi will have five husbands; on the way to Panchala Arjuna defeats the Gandharva Angaraparna, who tells them stories of the sages of old: Tapati and Samvarana, Vasishtha and Vishvamitra, Kalmashapada, Parashara and Aurva.

compilation.title: The Gandharva's Tales · The Complete Story

episodes.title: Born from the Fire
episodes.synopsis: A brahmin tells the Pandavas Drupada's story: seeking a son to kill Drona, he found the priests Yaja and Upayaja to perform a sacrifice. From the fire rose a young warrior in armour, Dhrishtadyumna, and from the altar a dark young woman, Krishnaa, Draupadi, of whom a voice said she would bring the kshatriyas to ruin.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then Vyasa came, and told them who she had been in another life.

episodes.title: Five Times "Husband"
episodes.synopsis: Vyasa visits the Pandavas and tells of a sage's daughter who, unable to find a husband, worshipped Shiva. Asked to choose a boon, she said "give me a husband with every virtue" five times, and so Shiva granted her five husbands in her next life. She is Draupadi. Go to Panchala, he says.
episodes.cliffhanger: On the way, at the Ganga by night, a Gandharva barred their path.

episodes.title: Arjuna and the Gandharva
episodes.synopsis: At night by the Ganga, the Gandharva king Angaraparna, sporting with his wives, attacks the Pandavas for intruding. Arjuna burns his chariot with the fire weapon and spares him at his wife's plea. In friendship he gives Arjuna the power to see whatever he wishes, and horses, and calls him "son of Tapati".
episodes.cliffhanger: "Who was Tapati?" asked Arjuna. And the Gandharva began to tell.

episodes.title: The Sun's Daughter
episodes.synopsis: King Samvarana, a Kuru ancestor, worships the Sun. Hunting on a mountain, he sees the Sun's daughter Tapati and falls senseless with love; she vanishes, and he waits on the mountain for twelve days, fasting.
episodes.cliffhanger: Only one person could ask the Sun for his daughter: the sage Vasishtha.

episodes.title: The Sage Who Asked the Sun
episodes.synopsis: Samvarana's priest Vasishtha goes up to the Sun and asks for Tapati on the king's behalf. The Sun gives her; the two marry and live on the mountain for twelve years while drought strikes his kingdom, until he returns. Their son is Kuru. So Arjuna, of Kuru's line, is "Tapatya".
episodes.cliffhanger: "Who was this Vasishtha?" And the Gandharva told of the sage's war with a king.

episodes.title: The Cow Vishvamitra Wanted
episodes.synopsis: King Vishvamitra, son of Gadhi, visits Vasishtha's hermitage and covets Nandini, his wish-granting cow. He tries to take her by force; she fights back, pouring out armies from her body. The king's army is routed, and Vishvamitra declares: fie on a kshatriya's strength, a brahmin's power is the true power. He turns to austerity and becomes a brahmin.
episodes.cliffhanger: And the rivalry between the two sages turned deadly.

episodes.title: The King Who Became a Rakshasa
episodes.synopsis: King Kalmashapada, on a narrow path, whips Vasishtha's son Shakti, who curses him to become a man-eating rakshasa. Vishvamitra seizes the chance and has a rakshasa enter the king. Kalmashapada devours Shakti, and then all of Vasishtha's hundred sons.
episodes.cliffhanger: Vasishtha wanted to die. The world would not let him.

episodes.title: The Sage Who Could Not Die
episodes.synopsis: Vasishtha throws himself from a mountain, into fire, into rivers bound with ropes; the river cuts his bonds (the Vipasha, "unbinding") and another scatters into a hundred streams (the Shatadru). Coming home he hears the Vedas being recited and finds it is the child in the womb of Shakti's widow Adrishyanti. He lives, frees Kalmashapada from the curse and gives the king a son.
episodes.cliffhanger: The child, Parashara, grew up and learned how his father died.

episodes.title: Aurva's Fire
episodes.synopsis: Parashara wants to destroy the worlds for his father's death. Vasishtha tells him of Aurva: when kings killed the Bhrigus for their wealth, a Bhrigu woman hid her child in her thigh; he burst out blazing and blinded the kings, and his anger, which would have burned the worlds, was cast into the ocean, where it still burns as a mare-headed fire.
episodes.cliffhanger: Parashara listened, and lit a different fire.

episodes.title: The Sacrifice of Rakshasas
episodes.synopsis: Parashara holds a sacrifice that burns rakshasas. The sage Pulastya, ancestor of the rakshasas, comes with others and persuades him to stop: anger is not the way of the wise. Parashara casts the fire into the Himalayan forest.
episodes.cliffhanger: His story told, the Gandharva gave the Pandavas one last piece of advice: find a priest.
episodes.notes: Parashara is Vyasa's father: the story loops back to the frame.

episodes.title: A Priest for the Pandavas
episodes.synopsis: Taking the Gandharva's advice, the Pandavas ask the sage Dhaumya, at the tirtha of Utkochaka, to be their family priest. With him they set off for Panchala, still disguised as brahmins.
episodes.cliffhanger: In Panchala, the whole world had come to win a princess.

arcs.title: Draupadi's Svayamvara
arcs.synopsis: Arjuna, disguised as a brahmin, strings the great bow and hits the target to win Draupadi; the kings attack; Kunti's unthinking "share it equally" leads to Draupadi marrying all five brothers, which Vyasa justifies with the tale of the five Indras. Krishna meets the Pandavas for the first time.
arcs.tradition_note: Two famous details are not in the CE text: the target as a revolving fish seen in a reflection (later retellings; the CE has a target behind an opening in a device), and Draupadi's public refusal of Karna as a charioteer's son (vulgate). The episodes mark them "As tradition tells it" if they are shown at all.

compilation.title: Draupadi's Svayamvara · The Complete Story

episodes.title: The Target in the Sky
episodes.synopsis: Drupada has a bow made that almost no one can bend and sets a target high above an opening in a device; whoever strings the bow and hits the target with five arrows wins Draupadi. Kings and princes from everywhere come; Krishna and Balarama watch; one after another, the kings fail.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then a young brahmin stood up.
episodes.notes: Shown as the CE describes it (a target behind an opening in a device). If the popular fish-and-reflection image is used instead, set tradition_note and show the "As tradition tells it" tag.

episodes.title: The Brahmin Who Strung the Bow
episodes.synopsis: Arjuna rises from among the brahmins. Some mock him, some hope. He strings the bow in a moment and brings down the target. Flowers fall; Draupadi, smiling, places the white garland on him.
episodes.cliffhanger: The kings would not let a brahmin take a princess.

episodes.title: The Kings Attack
episodes.synopsis: Enraged kings attack Drupada. Bhima uproots a tree; Arjuna fights Karna, who withdraws, unwilling to fight a brahmin he cannot defeat; Bhima throws Shalya. Krishna, recognising the Pandavas, calms the kings, and the brothers lead Draupadi home.
episodes.cliffhanger: "Mother, look what we got today!" And Kunti, not looking, answered.

episodes.title: "Share It Equally"
episodes.synopsis: At the potter's house where they are staying, the brothers announce the alms they have brought. Inside, Kunti says, "Share it all equally." Then she sees Draupadi, and is horrified: she has never spoken a false word. Yudhishthira, seeing his brothers' faces, decides that Draupadi will be the wife of all five.
episodes.cliffhanger: That night, two visitors came to the potter's house: Krishna and Balarama.

episodes.title: Krishna Meets the Pandavas
episodes.synopsis: Krishna and Balarama come to the potter's house, touch Yudhishthira's feet and greet their aunt Kunti. Krishna has guessed who the "brahmins" are. The first meeting of Krishna and the Pandavas.
episodes.cliffhanger: Outside, Draupadi's brother was hiding, listening.

episodes.title: The Spy in the Potter's House
episodes.synopsis: Dhrishtadyumna, hidden, watches the brothers and Draupadi: Kunti divides the food, they sleep on the floor with Draupadi at their feet, and they talk of weapons and war like kshatriyas. He reports to Drupada, who invites them to the palace and tests them with gifts: they go straight to the weapons.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then Yudhishthira told Drupada: all five of us will marry her.

episodes.title: One Bride, Five Husbands?
episodes.synopsis: Drupada is shocked: one woman, five husbands, is against all custom. Yudhishthira cites precedents (Jatila Gautami with seven sages, Varkshi with the ten Prachetas), and says his mother's words must be honoured. Then Vyasa arrives to settle it.
episodes.cliffhanger: He took Drupada aside and told him a secret about the five brothers.

episodes.title: The Five Indras
episodes.synopsis: Vyasa tells Drupada: once, Indra found a woman weeping into the Ganga, her tears turning into golden lotuses. She led him to a mountain where Shiva sat, and Shiva punished Indra's arrogance by shutting him in a cave with four earlier Indras. All five were to be born as men, the Pandavas, and the woman, Shri, as their wife. Vyasa gives Drupada divine sight, and he sees them as gods.
episodes.cliffhanger: Drupada agreed. And the wedding began.

episodes.title: The Wedding
episodes.synopsis: Draupadi marries the brothers on five successive days, in order of age. Kunti blesses her, and Krishna sends rich gifts. The news travels: the Pandavas are alive, and allied with Panchala.
episodes.cliffhanger: In Hastinapura, the news landed like a thunderbolt.

arcs.title: Indraprastha
arcs.synopsis: Hastinapura learns the Pandavas are alive; Duryodhana and Karna argue for treachery or war, Bhishma, Drona and Vidura for sharing the kingdom; the Pandavas return and are given the wilderness of Khandavaprastha, where they build Indraprastha. Narada warns them, with the tale of Sunda and Upasunda, not to quarrel over Draupadi.

compilation.title: Indraprastha · The Complete Story

episodes.title: "What Good Fortune!"
episodes.synopsis: Vidura tells Dhritarashtra that "the Kurus" have won Draupadi; the king, thinking he means Duryodhana, cries "what good fortune!" and orders gifts, until he learns it was the Pandavas. Alone with Duryodhana and Karna he admits his true feelings, and Duryodhana proposes schemes: divide the brothers, tempt Draupadi, kill Bhima.
episodes.cliffhanger: Karna had a simpler plan: attack now.

episodes.title: The Council of Elders
episodes.synopsis: Karna argues that tricks will not work on the Pandavas, only force, before they grow stronger. Bhishma says: give them half the kingdom; it is theirs by right. Drona agrees, and Karna accuses him of disloyalty. Vidura warns the king that the elders are right. Dhritarashtra gives in.
episodes.cliffhanger: Vidura was sent to bring the Pandavas home.

episodes.title: Half a Kingdom of Forest
episodes.synopsis: Vidura brings the Pandavas, Kunti and Draupadi back to Hastinapura. Dhritarashtra gives them half the kingdom: the wild Khandavaprastha. With Krishna's help they build a splendid city there, Indraprastha, and the people flock to it.
episodes.cliffhanger: One day the sage Narada came, with a warning.

episodes.title: Narada's Warning
episodes.synopsis: Narada sees five brothers and one wife, and warns them how brothers who love one another can be destroyed by one woman. He tells of two asura brothers, Sunda and Upasunda, inseparable in everything, who won a boon from Brahma by fearsome austerities: no one but each other could kill them.
episodes.cliffhanger: With that boon, they set out to conquer the three worlds.

episodes.title: Tilottama
episodes.synopsis: Sunda and Upasunda ravage the worlds. Brahma has a woman made from the finest particle of every beautiful thing, Tilottama, and sends her to them. Both brothers grab her hand, quarrel, and kill each other with their maces. The Pandavas make a rule: whoever intrudes on one brother alone with Draupadi will go into the forest for twelve years.
episodes.cliffhanger: It would not be long before someone had to break that rule.

arcs.title: Arjuna's Exile and Subhadra
arcs.synopsis: Arjuna breaks the rule to save a brahmin's cows and goes into exile: the Naga princess Ulupi, Chitrangada of Manipura, five cursed apsaras freed, and Krishna at Prabhasa; at Dvaraka he carries off Krishna's sister Subhadra with Krishna's blessing. Abhimanyu and Draupadi's sons are born.

compilation.title: Arjuna's Exile and Subhadra · The Complete Story

episodes.title: The Broken Rule
episodes.synopsis: Thieves steal a brahmin's cows, and he cries for help at the palace. Arjuna's weapons are in the room where Yudhishthira is alone with Draupadi. He goes in, takes his bow, recovers the cows, and insists on going into exile, though Yudhishthira forgives him.
episodes.cliffhanger: At the Ganga, a serpent princess pulled him under the water.

episodes.title: Ulupi
episodes.synopsis: At Gangadvara, as Arjuna bathes, the Naga princess Ulupi pulls him down into her father's palace and asks him to love her. He hesitates over his vow; she argues that saving a life is dharma too, and he stays the night.
episodes.cliffhanger: He travelled on, east and south, to a kingdom by the sea.
episodes.notes: Their son Iravat is named only later, in the Bhishma Parva.

episodes.title: Chitrangada of Manipura
episodes.synopsis: In Manipura Arjuna asks King Chitravahana for his daughter Chitrangada. The king agrees on one condition: her son will stay to continue his line. Arjuna lives there three years; their son is Babhruvahana.
episodes.cliffhanger: At the southern sea, five pools stood empty. Everyone was afraid to bathe there.

episodes.title: The Crocodile Maidens
episodes.synopsis: At five holy pools in the south, ascetics warn Arjuna: crocodiles live there. One seizes him; he drags it out, and it turns into a lovely apsara, Varga. She and four friends were cursed by a sage they tried to tempt; a hero would free them. Arjuna frees the other four.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then he went to Prabhasa, and Krishna came to meet him.

episodes.title: Krishna at Prabhasa
episodes.synopsis: Krishna meets Arjuna at Prabhasa; they spend days together on Mount Raivataka, and Krishna brings him to Dvaraka, where the Vrishnis welcome him.
episodes.cliffhanger: At a festival on the mountain, Arjuna saw Krishna's sister.

episodes.title: The Festival on Raivataka
episodes.synopsis: At the Vrishnis' festival on Mount Raivataka, Arjuna sees Subhadra, Krishna's sister, and falls in love. Krishna, smiling, advises him: a svayamvara is uncertain; for a kshatriya, carrying off the bride is an honoured way. Yudhishthira, asked by messenger, consents.
episodes.cliffhanger: Arjuna waited for her by the road with a chariot.

episodes.title: Subhadra Carried Off
episodes.synopsis: Arjuna carries off Subhadra as she returns from worship. The guards raise the alarm; the Vrishni and Andhaka warriors arm for war, and Balarama is furious at the insult. Krishna calms them: Arjuna is a worthy husband who did nothing dishonourable; bring him back as a friend.
episodes.cliffhanger: Arjuna came home after twelve years, with a second bride. Draupadi was not pleased.
episodes.notes: That Subhadra herself drove the chariot is a later tradition; in the CE Arjuna takes her away in the chariot.

episodes.title: Gifts and Sons
episodes.synopsis: Arjuna returns to Indraprastha. Draupadi greets him with a jealous jibe; Subhadra comes to her dressed as a cowherd girl and bows: "I am your servant." Krishna arrives with a rich dowry. Subhadra bears Abhimanyu, and Draupadi bears five sons, one by each brother.
episodes.cliffhanger: One hot summer, Krishna and Arjuna went to the Yamuna, and met a hungry brahmin.

arcs.title: The Burning of Khandava
arcs.synopsis: Agni, sick and hungry, asks Krishna and Arjuna to let him consume the Khandava forest, which Indra protects for Takshaka; he arms them with the Gandiva bow and the Sudarshana discus. They hold off Indra and every creature while the forest burns. Only Takshaka's son, the asura Maya and four young birds escape. Season finale.
arcs.tradition_note: The story of why Agni was sick (King Shvetaki's twelve-year sacrifice of ghee) is believed to be in the CE apparatus rather than its text; if told, mark it "As tradition tells it".

compilation.title: The Burning of Khandava · The Complete Story

episodes.title: A Brahmin by the Yamuna
episodes.synopsis: Krishna and Arjuna are picnicking by the Yamuna when a huge, blazing brahmin asks them for food. He is Agni: he wants to consume the Khandava forest, but Indra protects it with rain because his friend Takshaka lives there. He needs two heroes to hold Indra off.
episodes.cliffhanger: Arjuna said yes, but asked for a bow equal to the task.

episodes.title: Gandiva
episodes.synopsis: Agni calls Varuna, who gives Arjuna the Gandiva bow, two inexhaustible quivers and a chariot with white horses and a monkey on its banner; Krishna receives the discus Sudarshana and the mace Kaumodaki.
episodes.cliffhanger: Agni flared up, and the forest began to burn.

episodes.title: The Forest Burns
episodes.synopsis: The forest burns on every side while Krishna and Arjuna circle it and let nothing escape. Takshaka is away at Kurukshetra. His son Ashvasena's mother swallows him to carry him out; Arjuna cuts off her head, and Indra's wind blows Ashvasena free. Arjuna, Krishna and Agni curse him, and Ashvasena swears enmity.
episodes.cliffhanger: Then Indra came down with all the gods to fight.
episodes.notes: Ashvasena returns at Karna's duel with Arjuna (Season 8).

episodes.title: Arjuna Against Indra
episodes.synopsis: Indra pours rain on the fire; Arjuna dries it with a canopy of arrows. The gods attack and are driven back; Indra hurls a mountain peak. Then a voice from the sky tells Indra: these are Nara and Narayana, you cannot defeat them; and Takshaka is safe. Indra withdraws, proud of his son.
episodes.cliffhanger: In the flames, one voice cried out to Arjuna for mercy.

episodes.title: Maya Is Spared
episodes.synopsis: The asura Maya, the great architect, runs from the fire with Krishna's discus raised behind him and Agni at his heels. He cries out to Arjuna for protection; Arjuna says "do not fear", and Krishna and Agni let him go. Maya promises to repay him.
episodes.cliffhanger: In the middle of the fire, four fledglings were praying.

episodes.title: The Four Fledglings
episodes.synopsis: The sage Mandapala, refused heaven because he had no sons, became a sharngaka bird and fathered four sons with Jarita, then left them in the Khandava. As the fire comes, Jarita cannot save them; the fledglings, wise as sages, praise Agni, and he spares them. Mandapala returns to a family that is in no hurry to forgive him.
episodes.cliffhanger: The fire was satisfied. Indra came down to Arjuna with a promise.

episodes.title: Indra's Promise
episodes.synopsis: Agni, sated, departs. Indra, pleased, promises Arjuna all his divine weapons when the time comes, after Arjuna has pleased Shiva, and Krishna asks for one boon: eternal friendship with Arjuna. The forest is ash. Maya owes Arjuna a debt, and will pay it with a hall that will change everything.
episodes.cliffhanger: Next season: the Hall of Maya, the royal sacrifice, and a game of dice.

seasons.title: The Hall and the Dice
seasons.summary: Maya builds the Pandavas a marvellous hall; Yudhishthira performs the royal consecration after Jarasandha is killed and the four brothers conquer the four directions; Krishna kills Shishupala. Humiliated in the hall, Duryodhana has Shakuni win everything from Yudhishthira at dice, including Draupadi, who is dragged into the assembly. A second game sends the Pandavas into thirteen years of exile.

arcs.title: The Hall of Maya
arcs.synopsis: Maya repays his debt with a hall of illusions for Yudhishthira, and fetches Bhima's mace and Arjuna's conch Devadatta from Lake Bindusaras. Narada visits and describes the halls of Indra, Yama, Varuna, Kubera and Brahma, and brings a message from Pandu in Yama's hall: perform the Rajasuya.
arcs.reorder_note: Narada's questions to the king (2.5) come between the hall and his description of the gods' halls (2.6–11); we tell the halls with the hall and give the questions their own arc after it.

compilation.title: The Hall of Maya · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Narada's Questions
arcs.synopsis: Narada visits the new hall and questions Yudhishthira on every duty of a king ("Do you…?"): the kaccit chapter, a complete handbook of governance in questions.

compilation.title: Narada's Questions · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Jarasandha
arcs.synopsis: Krishna explains that Jarasandha of Magadha, who holds eighty-six kings captive for sacrifice, must fall first; the story of his birth in two halves joined by the rakshasi Jara; Krishna, Bhima and Arjuna enter Girivraja disguised as snataka brahmins; Bhima wrestles Jarasandha for thirteen days and tears him in two.
tales: The birth of Jarasandha (Jara joins the two halves)

compilation.title: Jarasandha · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Conquering the Four Directions
arcs.synopsis: Arjuna goes north, Bhima east, Sahadeva south and Nakula west, gathering tribute for the Rajasuya; set pieces include Arjuna among the northern peoples and Sahadeva's embassy as far as Lanka.

compilation.title: Conquering the Four Directions · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Royal Consecration and Shishupala
arcs.synopsis: The Rajasuya; Bhishma proposes that the first honour go to Krishna; Shishupala of Chedi insults Krishna, Bhishma and the assembly; Bhishma tells of Shishupala's birth and the promise to forgive a hundred offences; Krishna's discus ends it.

compilation.title: The Royal Consecration and Shishupala · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Duryodhana in the Hall
arcs.synopsis: Duryodhana stays on in the hall, mistakes crystal for water and water for crystal, and is laughed at; his envy at the Pandavas' wealth; Shakuni proposes the game of dice and they persuade Dhritarashtra over Vidura's warnings.
arcs.tradition_note: Draupadi's taunt "the blind man's son is blind" is not in the CE text; it is a later addition. The CE has Bhima, Arjuna, the twins and attendants laughing.

compilation.title: Duryodhana in the Hall · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Game of Dice
arcs.synopsis: Vidura brings the invitation; Yudhishthira cannot refuse a challenge; Shakuni plays for Duryodhana and wins the treasury, the kingdom, the brothers, Yudhishthira himself and Draupadi. Duhshasana drags Draupadi into the assembly; her question (did he lose himself before he staked me?) goes unanswered by the elders; Vikarna alone speaks; Karna calls her a whore; as Duhshasana pulls at her garment, garment after garment appears; Bhima's vows; jackals howl and Dhritarashtra grants Draupadi boons that free her husbands.
arcs.tradition_note: In the CE the endless garment appears without any prayer to Krishna; Draupadi's invocation of Krishna (and Krishna's role) is a vulgate addition. Shown, it carries "As tradition tells it".

compilation.title: The Game of Dice · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Second Game
arcs.synopsis: Duryodhana persuades his father to recall the Pandavas for one more throw: the loser goes to the forest for twelve years and a thirteenth in hiding. They lose. The Pandavas leave, each in his own manner, and Draupadi with her hair unbound; Vidura reads the omens; Kunti stays with Vidura.

compilation.title: The Second Game · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Forest Years
seasons.summary: Twelve years in the forest, the richest season for stories. Arjuna wins the Pashupata from Shiva and weapons in Indra's heaven; the brothers make a pilgrimage across India while sages tell them tales (Nala and Damayanti, Agastya, the descent of the Ganga, Rishyashringa, Savitri, Rama). Bhima meets Hanuman; Jayadratha abducts Draupadi; Indra takes Karna's armour; the Yaksha questions Yudhishthira.
seasons.upaparvas_note: The CE's grouping of the Aranyaka sub-parvas differs from the vulgate (e.g. Nala inside Indralokabhigamana, Rama and Savitri inside Draupadiharana); adhyaya ranges here are approximate.

arcs.title: Into the Forest
arcs.synopsis: The citizens follow the Pandavas; Yudhishthira praises the Sun and receives a vessel that feeds all their guests; Vidura, banished for his counsel, joins them and is recalled; Vyasa and Maitreya warn Dhritarashtra, and Maitreya curses Duryodhana to have his thigh broken. On the way to the Kamyaka forest, the rakshasa Kirmira, Baka's brother, bars the path; Bhima kills him.

compilation.title: Into the Forest · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Krishna in the Forest and the Fall of Saubha
arcs.synopsis: Krishna visits and Draupadi pours out her grief and anger; Krishna explains he was away fighting Shalva and his flying city Saubha, and tells that war.
tales: Shalva and the flying city of Saubha

compilation.title: Krishna in the Forest and the Fall of Saubha · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Anger and Forgiveness
arcs.synopsis: The great forest debates: Draupadi and Bhima argue that a king must act and fight; Yudhishthira defends forbearance and keeping his word. Bali and Prahlada on forgiveness; fate against human effort. Vyasa teaches Yudhishthira the Pratismriti spell for Arjuna.

compilation.title: Anger and Forgiveness · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Hunter and the Bow
arcs.synopsis: Arjuna goes alone to the Himalaya to win divine weapons; Indra in disguise tests him; after fierce austerities he fights a mountain hunter over a boar, cannot defeat him, and recognises Shiva, who gives him the Pashupata; the world-guardians give their weapons.

compilation.title: The Hunter and the Bow · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Arjuna in Indra's Heaven
arcs.synopsis: Matali's chariot carries Arjuna to Amaravati; he learns weapons and music and dance from the Gandharva Chitrasena; Lomasha brings news of him to the brothers.
arcs.tradition_note: Urvashi's curse on Arjuna (a year as a eunuch, used in Virata) is believed to be outside the CE's constituted text; marked "As tradition tells it" if told.

compilation.title: Arjuna in Indra's Heaven · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Nala and Damayanti
arcs.synopsis: Told by the sage Brihadashva to a grieving Yudhishthira: the swan messenger; Damayanti chooses Nala over four gods at her svayamvara; Kali possesses Nala, who loses everything at dice and abandons her in the forest; the serpent Karkotaka's bite disguises him as a charioteer; Damayanti's search and second svayamvara; the knowledge of dice and horses exchanged with King Rituparna; recognition and restoration.

compilation.title: Nala and Damayanti · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Pilgrimage Begins
arcs.synopsis: Narada and Pulastya describe the holy places; the sage Lomasha arrives from heaven and leads the brothers on a pilgrimage across India.

compilation.title: The Pilgrimage Begins · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Agastya
arcs.synopsis: Tales told along the way: Agastya and Lopamudra; the demons Vatapi and Ilvala (Agastya digests Vatapi); Agastya stops the Vindhya mountain from growing and drinks the ocean so the gods can kill the Kalakeyas hiding in it.

compilation.title: Agastya · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Descent of the Ganga
arcs.synopsis: King Sagara's sixty thousand sons dig up the earth looking for the sacrificial horse and are burned by Kapila's gaze; generations later Bhagiratha's austerities bring the Ganga down from heaven, and Shiva bears her fall on his head.

compilation.title: The Descent of the Ganga · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Rishyashringa
arcs.synopsis: The deer-horned boy raised in the forest who has never seen a woman; a courtesan is sent to lure him to drought-struck Anga, and the rain follows him.

compilation.title: Rishyashringa · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Parashurama's Story
arcs.synopsis: The birth of Parashurama; his father Jamadagni orders him to kill his mother Renuka and he obeys, then asks for her life back; King Kartavirya steals Jamadagni's calf, Parashurama kills him, Kartavirya's sons kill Jamadagni, and Parashurama rids the earth of kshatriyas twenty-one times.
arcs.reorder_note: Completes the story begun in episode 2 (the five lakes).

compilation.title: Parashurama's Story · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Kings and Sages of Old
arcs.synopsis: Princess Sukanya pokes the eyes of the old sage Chyavana, buried in an anthill, and marries him in atonement; the Ashvins make him young and he wins them a share of the soma, paralysing Indra's arm. Mandhata, born from his father's side; Somaka and his one son Jantu; Shibi, who gives his own flesh to save a dove from a hawk (Indra and Agni testing him).

compilation.title: Kings and Sages of Old · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Ashtavakra and Yavakri
arcs.synopsis: The boy cursed in the womb by his father to be bent in eight places defeats the court debater Bandin at King Janaka's court and frees his drowned father. Yavakri wins the Vedas by austerity instead of study, insults Raibhya, and dies by the demon Raibhya creates; Paravasu kills his father by mistake.

compilation.title: Ashtavakra and Yavakri · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Flower and the Monkey
arcs.synopsis: Into the high Himalaya; Draupadi wants the saugandhika flower; Bhima's path is blocked by an old monkey who is his brother Hanuman, son of Vayu, who shows his giant form and teaches him the ages and the duties; Bhima fights the Yakshas at Kubera's lake; the rakshasa Jatasura carries off Yudhishthira, the twins and Draupadi and is killed.

compilation.title: The Flower and the Monkey · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Arjuna Returns
arcs.synopsis: The brothers reach Mount Gandhamadana; Arjuna returns in Indra's chariot and tells of destroying the Nivatakavachas under the sea and the flying city of the Paulomas and Kalakeyas.

compilation.title: Arjuna Returns · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Python
arcs.synopsis: A huge python seizes Bhima. It is King Nahusha, cursed by Agastya; Yudhishthira answers his questions on who is a brahmin, truth and conduct, and frees both.

compilation.title: The Python · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Markandeya: the End of the World
arcs.synopsis: The ageless sage Markandeya tells of the ages and the dissolution: alone in the cosmic flood he finds a child on a banyan branch and enters his body to see all the worlds within. Also: Vaivasvata Manu and the fish that grows.

compilation.title: Markandeya: the End of the World · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Markandeya's Kings
arcs.synopsis: More of Markandeya's stories: King Parikshit of Ayodhya and the frog princess; Vamadeva's horses; Indradyumna, fallen from heaven because no one remembered him, and the creatures old enough to remember; Dhundhumara, the king who killed the demon Dhundhu under the sands.
arcs.reorder_note: These tales are scattered through Markandeya's discourse (3.188–195); gathered into one side arc.

compilation.title: Markandeya's Kings · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Faithful Wife and the Butcher
arcs.synopsis: The proud ascetic Kaushika burns a crane with a look and is put in his place by a housewife, who sends him to a butcher in Mithila; the dharmavyadha teaches him that duty done well is holiness. Satyabhama asks Draupadi how she keeps five husbands devoted; Draupadi's answer.
arcs.reorder_note: Draupadi and Satyabhama (3.222–224) follows Skanda (3.213–221) in the CE; we group it with the other dialogue on a householder's dharma.

compilation.title: The Faithful Wife and the Butcher · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Birth of Skanda
arcs.synopsis: The birth of Skanda, the war-god, from Agni and Svaha, who took the forms of the sages' wives (the epic also calls him Rudra's son); the Krittikas; his consecration as general of the gods.

compilation.title: The Birth of Skanda · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Cattle Expedition
arcs.synopsis: Duryodhana goes to gloat over the exiles under cover of counting cattle; the Gandharvas capture him; Arjuna and Bhima free him at Yudhishthira's order; humiliated, Duryodhana resolves to fast to death and is roused by the danavas; Karna conquers the world for him and he performs the Vaishnava sacrifice.

compilation.title: The Cattle Expedition · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Durvasa and Mudgala
arcs.synopsis: Duryodhana sends the irascible Durvasa and his ten thousand disciples to the Pandavas after their meal; Krishna eats the last leaf in Draupadi's pot and the sages feel full (as tradition tells it). A deer's dream moves the brothers to another forest; Vyasa tells of the sage Mudgala, who lives on a measure of gleaned grain, feeds Durvasa without anger, and declines heaven when he learns its limits.
arcs.tradition_note: The Durvasa visit and Krishna eating the last leaf are a vulgate episode outside the CE's constituted text; marked "As tradition tells it".

compilation.title: Durvasa and Mudgala · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Draupadi Abducted
arcs.synopsis: Jayadratha of Sindhu, Duryodhana's brother-in-law, finds Draupadi alone and carries her off; the Pandavas pursue, Bhima shaves his head into five tufts, and Yudhishthira spares him for Duhshala's sake. Jayadratha wins a boon from Shiva: to hold back four Pandavas for a day.

compilation.title: Draupadi Abducted · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Story of Rama
arcs.synopsis: Markandeya consoles Yudhishthira with the story of Rama: Ravana's origin, Rama's exile, Sita's abduction, Hanuman, the bridge, the war, the fire ordeal, the return. The epic's own short Ramayana.

compilation.title: The Story of Rama · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Savitri
arcs.synopsis: Princess Savitri chooses Satyavan, who is fated to die within a year; on the day, she follows Yama as he carries Satyavan's life away, and with her wisdom wins boons until he must give it back.

compilation.title: Savitri · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Karna's Armour
arcs.synopsis: Surya warns Karna in a dream that Indra will come begging for his armour and earrings; Karna will not refuse a request; he cuts them from his body and receives Indra's spear, good for one kill. Kunti's story of his birth is told again.

compilation.title: Karna's Armour · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Yaksha's Questions
arcs.synopsis: A brahmin's fire-sticks are carried off by a deer; chasing it, the brothers find a lake guarded by a voice; four drink without answering and fall dead; Yudhishthira answers the Yaksha's riddles ("what is the greatest wonder?"), chooses Nakula's life, and the Yaksha reveals himself as Dharma. The thirteenth year begins.

compilation.title: The Yaksha's Questions · The Complete Story

seasons.title: In Disguise
seasons.summary: The thirteenth year, in hiding at King Virata's court in Matsya: Yudhishthira as a dice-playing courtier, Bhima as a cook, Arjuna as the dance teacher Brihannala, the twins as horse- and cowherd, Draupadi as a maid. Bhima kills Kichaka; the Kauravas raid Matsya's cattle, and Arjuna, with Prince Uttara as charioteer, routs them all.

arcs.title: Into Disguise
arcs.synopsis: Choosing disguises; Dhaumya's counsel on serving a king; the weapons hidden in a shami tree; arriving at Virata's court; Bhima wrestles for the king.

compilation.title: Into Disguise · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Kichaka
arcs.synopsis: The queen's brother, Kichaka, the army commander, lusts after the maid Sairandhri (Draupadi) and kicks her in front of the king; Bhima, waiting in the dark dance hall where Kichaka expects Sairandhri, crushes him to a ball; Kichaka's brothers are killed too.

compilation.title: Kichaka · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Cattle Raid
arcs.synopsis: Trigartas and Kauravas raid Matsya's cattle; Prince Uttara boasts, panics and flees; Brihannala reveals himself as Arjuna, takes the Gandiva from the shami tree and defeats Karna, Drona, Kripa, Ashvatthama, Bhishma and Duryodhana, stunning them all with a weapon and taking their clothes. Was the year over? Bhishma's reckoning.

compilation.title: The Cattle Raid · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Revealed
arcs.synopsis: Virata strikes Yudhishthira with a die for praising Brihannala over Uttara; the Pandavas reveal themselves; Arjuna declines Princess Uttaraa as his own bride and accepts her for his son Abhimanyu.

compilation.title: Revealed · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Road to War
seasons.summary: The effort for peace and the preparations for war. Arjuna chooses Krishna, Duryodhana his army; embassies go back and forth; Vidura counsels the sleepless king; Krishna himself goes to Hastinapura and shows his cosmic form; Kunti and Krishna each tell Karna the truth of his birth. Bhishma tells why he will not fight Shikhandin: the story of Amba.

arcs.title: Choosing Sides
arcs.synopsis: At Virata's court the allies plan; Arjuna and Duryodhana come to Krishna at the same time: one may have Krishna unarmed, the other his army, and Arjuna chooses Krishna. Shalya, the twins' uncle, is tricked by Duryodhana's hospitality into fighting for the Kauravas, and promises Yudhishthira to undermine Karna.

compilation.title: Choosing Sides · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Indra, Vritra and Nahusha
arcs.synopsis: Shalya consoles Yudhishthira with Indra's own fall: Indra kills Trishiras and Vritra and must hide; Nahusha becomes Indra and lusts after Shachi; the sages carry his palanquin until Agastya curses him to become a serpent.

compilation.title: Indra, Vritra and Nahusha · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Sanjaya's Embassy
arcs.synopsis: Drupada's priest goes to Hastinapura; Sanjaya comes to the Pandavas with soft words and no offer; Yudhishthira asks only five villages.

compilation.title: Sanjaya's Embassy · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Vidura's Counsel
arcs.synopsis: The sleepless king calls Vidura in the night: Vidura's great teaching on the wise and the foolish, kingship, speech, anger and greed (Vidura Niti).

compilation.title: Vidura's Counsel · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Eternal Youth
arcs.synopsis: The ancient sage Sanatsujata teaches Dhritarashtra about death, which is heedlessness, and about Brahman (the Sanatsujatiya).

compilation.title: The Eternal Youth · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Councils
arcs.synopsis: Sanjaya reports in the Kuru assembly; Bhishma, Drona and Dhritarashtra warn Duryodhana, who boasts; Karna and Bhishma quarrel; Sanjaya describes Krishna's greatness.

compilation.title: The Councils · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Krishna's Peace Mission
arcs.synopsis: Krishna goes to Hastinapura as envoy; he stays with Vidura; Draupadi shows him her unbound hair; in the assembly sages and elders plead, Duryodhana refuses even a needle's point of land and plans to seize Krishna, who shows his universal form and walks out.

compilation.title: Krishna's Peace Mission · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Tales Told in the Assembly
arcs.synopsis: Stories told to soften Duryodhana: Dambhodbhava, the king who challenged Nara and Narayana; Matali, Indra's charioteer, searching the worlds for a husband for his daughter; Galava, who must find eight hundred white horses with one black ear for his teacher's fee, and Yayati's daughter Madhavi, given to four kings in turn.
arcs.reorder_note: These tales sit inside the peace mission; we gather them into one side arc after it.

compilation.title: Tales Told in the Assembly · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Kunti's Message and Karna's Choice
arcs.synopsis: Kunti's message to her sons: the story of Vidula, the queen who roused her defeated son to fight. Krishna tells Karna he is Kunti's firstborn and offers him the kingdom and Draupadi; Karna refuses for Duryodhana's sake and Radha's; Kunti comes to him at the river; he promises to spare four of her sons: she will always have five.

compilation.title: Kunti's Message and Karna's Choice · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Armies March
arcs.synopsis: The Pandavas choose Dhrishtadyumna as commander and the Kauravas Bhishma; Balarama goes on pilgrimage rather than fight; Rukmi is refused; Uluka carries Duryodhana's taunts; Bhishma counts the great chariot-warriors and slights Karna, who vows not to fight while Bhishma lives.

compilation.title: The Armies March · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Amba
arcs.synopsis: Bhishma explains why he will not fight Shikhandin: Amba, rejected by Shalva, sought revenge; Parashurama fought Bhishma for her for twenty-three days and could not win; she burned herself to be reborn as Drupada's child, Shikhandin, who exchanged sex with a Yaksha.
arcs.reorder_note: Completes Amba's story begun in Season 1 (Three Princesses of Kashi).

compilation.title: Amba · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Song and the Fall
seasons.summary: Vyasa gives Sanjaya divine sight to report the war. On the first day Arjuna's despair draws out the Bhagavad Gita. Ten days of battle under Bhishma, until Bhishma tells the Pandavas how he can be defeated and falls on a bed of arrows behind Shikhandin.
seasons.reorder_note: In the CE Sanjaya returns to Dhritarashtra after Bhishma's fall on the tenth day (6.14) and narrates days 1–10, including the Gita, as a flashback. We tell the days in order, with Sanjaya's report as the frame; season opener notes this.

arcs.title: Before the Battle
arcs.synopsis: The rules of war agreed; Vyasa offers Dhritarashtra sight and gives Sanjaya divine vision instead; omens; Sanjaya describes the earth and its continents (summarised).

compilation.title: Before the Battle · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Bhagavad Gita I: Despair and the Self (chapters 1–6)
arcs.synopsis: Arjuna sees his kin and teachers and lays down his bow; Krishna teaches the undying self, action without attachment to its fruits, knowledge, renunciation and meditation. Three Shorts per chapter.

compilation.title: The Bhagavad Gita I: Despair and the Self (chapters 1–6) · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Bhagavad Gita II: The Vision (chapters 7–12)
arcs.synopsis: Knowledge and realisation, the imperishable, the royal secret, the divine glories, the universal form that Arjuna begs to see and fears, and devotion.

compilation.title: The Bhagavad Gita II: The Vision (chapters 7–12) · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Bhagavad Gita III: The Field and the Choice (chapters 13–18)
arcs.synopsis: The field and its knower, the three gunas, the cosmic tree, the divine and demonic natures, the three kinds of faith, and liberation: "Do as you choose." Arjuna takes up his bow.

compilation.title: The Bhagavad Gita III: The Field and the Choice (chapters 13–18) · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Days One to Three
arcs.synopsis: Yudhishthira walks unarmed to the enemy to ask his elders' blessing; the first clash and Uttara's brother Shveta killed; Bhishma's mastery; on the third day Krishna, angered by Arjuna's mildness, leaps down with his discus to kill Bhishma (the chariot wheel is a later retelling's image), and Arjuna holds him back.

compilation.title: Days One to Three · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Days Four to Six
arcs.synopsis: Bhima's rampage among Dhritarashtra's sons; Ghatotkacha; the formations (makara, krauncha, shyena); Duryodhana's complaints to Bhishma.

compilation.title: Days Four to Six · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Days Seven to Nine
arcs.synopsis: Iravat, Arjuna's son by Ulupi, is killed; Bhima kills more of the Kauravas; on the ninth day Krishna again rises against Bhishma; that night the Pandavas go to Bhishma's tent and he tells them how he may be brought down.

compilation.title: Days Seven to Nine · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Fall of Bhishma
arcs.synopsis: The tenth day: Arjuna shoots from behind Shikhandin; Bhishma, pierced all over, falls and lies on a bed of arrows, waiting for the sun's northern course; Arjuna gives him a pillow of arrows and draws water from the earth; Karna comes to him at night.

compilation.title: The Fall of Bhishma · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Teacher's War
seasons.summary: Drona commands the Kauravas for five days. Abhimanyu breaks into the wheel formation and is killed; Arjuna vows to kill Jayadratha by sunset or burn himself; Karna spends Indra's spear on Ghatotkacha; Drona lays down his arms when told "Ashvatthama is dead", and Ashvatthama unleashes the Narayana weapon.

arcs.title: Drona Takes Command
arcs.synopsis: Karna enters the battle; Drona is made commander and promises to capture Yudhishthira alive if Arjuna can be drawn away.

compilation.title: Drona Takes Command · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Oath-Bound and Bhagadatta
arcs.synopsis: The Samshaptakas swear to kill Arjuna or die and lure him away; the old king Bhagadatta on his elephant Supratika and the Vaishnava weapon Krishna takes on his own chest.

compilation.title: The Oath-Bound and Bhagadatta · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Abhimanyu
arcs.synopsis: With Arjuna away, the sixteen-year-old Abhimanyu breaks into Drona's wheel formation; Jayadratha, using Shiva's boon, holds the other Pandavas at the gap; Abhimanyu fights six great warriors at once and is killed fighting with a chariot wheel. Vyasa consoles Yudhishthira with the story of the goddess of Death, who wept at her task, and Narada's tale of the sixteen great kings who died (the Shodasharajika).

compilation.title: Abhimanyu · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Arjuna's Vow
arcs.synopsis: Arjuna learns how his son died and vows to kill Jayadratha before sunset or enter the fire; Jayadratha wants to flee and is kept with promises of protection; Krishna and Arjuna's night journey, in a dream, to Shiva to renew the Pashupata; Subhadra's grief.

compilation.title: Arjuna's Vow · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Satyaki and Bhima Break Through
arcs.synopsis: The fourteenth day: Arjuna cuts through Drona's formations toward Jayadratha; his horses tire and Krishna waters them on the battlefield; Yudhishthira sends Satyaki and then Bhima after him; Bhima spares Karna's life and Karna spares Bhima's; Bhurishravas is about to kill Satyaki when Arjuna cuts off his arm, and Satyaki beheads him at prayer.

compilation.title: Satyaki and Bhima Break Through · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Jayadratha
arcs.synopsis: The race against the sun: six great warriors guard Jayadratha; as the sun sinks Arjuna reaches him, and his arrow carries Jayadratha's head into the lap of his father Vriddhakshatra, whose own curse then strikes him.
arcs.tradition_note: UNCERTAIN: Krishna darkening the sun (with his discus, in popular retellings) so that Jayadratha shows himself. Check the CE text before showing it; if it is not in the constituted text, mark it "As tradition tells it".

compilation.title: Jayadratha · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Night Battle and Ghatotkacha
arcs.synopsis: The war goes on into the night by torchlight; Ghatotkacha's illusions terrify the Kauravas until Karna must spend Indra's spear, saved for Arjuna, to kill him; Krishna rejoices.

compilation.title: The Night Battle and Ghatotkacha · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Ashvatthama Is Dead
arcs.synopsis: Drona is unstoppable; Krishna has Bhima kill an elephant named Ashvatthama; Yudhishthira, who never lies, says "Ashvatthama is dead" and mutters "the elephant"; his chariot touches the ground; Drona lays down his weapons and Dhrishtadyumna beheads him.

compilation.title: Ashvatthama Is Dead · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Narayana Weapon
arcs.synopsis: Ashvatthama, in grief and rage, looses the Narayana weapon; Krishna tells everyone to drop their arms and bow; Bhima resists and has to be dragged down. Vyasa tells Arjuna of the figure he saw going before him in battle: Shiva.

compilation.title: The Narayana Weapon · The Complete Story

seasons.title: Karna
seasons.summary: Karna commands for two days, with Shalya as his reluctant charioteer. Bhima drinks Duhshasana's blood; Yudhishthira insults Arjuna and Arjuna nearly kills him; and Karna, his chariot wheel stuck in the earth and his weapons forgotten, is killed by Arjuna.

arcs.title: Karna Commands
arcs.synopsis: Karna is made commander; he asks for Shalya as charioteer; Shalya agrees only on condition he may speak as he likes, and mocks him; Karna boasts and curses. Shalya taunts Karna with the fable of a crow, fattened on leftovers, who challenged the swans to a flight over the ocean.

compilation.title: Karna Commands · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Sixteenth Day and the Seventeenth Morning
arcs.synopsis: Karna defeats Yudhishthira, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva and spares them as he promised Kunti; Ashvatthama and Arjuna duel.

compilation.title: The Sixteenth Day and the Seventeenth Morning · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Arjuna's Dilemma
arcs.synopsis: Wounded, Yudhishthira insults Arjuna's Gandiva; Arjuna has vowed to kill anyone who does; Krishna teaches the subtlety of truth with the hunter Balaka and the ascetic Kaushika, and Arjuna "kills" his brother with harsh words, then himself with self-praise.

compilation.title: Arjuna's Dilemma · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Duhshasana's Blood
arcs.synopsis: Bhima kills Duhshasana and drinks his blood, fulfilling the vow from the dice hall.

compilation.title: Duhshasana's Blood · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Karna and Arjuna
arcs.synopsis: The great duel; the serpent Ashvasena in Karna's arrow, which Krishna dodges by pressing the chariot into the earth; the earth swallows Karna's wheel and he forgets the Brahmastra (Parashurama's and a brahmin's curses); he asks for fair play; Krishna reminds him of Draupadi and Abhimanyu; Arjuna's arrow.
