arcs.reorder_note: The full stories of Karna's curses (Parashurama and the stinging insect; the brahmin's cow) are told by Narada in the Shanti Parva (12.1–5); we preview them here and tell them in Season 12.

compilation.title: Karna and Arjuna · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Last Day
seasons.summary: The eighteenth day: Shalya commands and is killed by Yudhishthira; Sahadeva kills Shakuni; Duryodhana hides in a lake. Balarama, back from pilgrimage (whose tirthas are told as side tales), watches Bhima break Duryodhana's thigh with a foul blow.

arcs.title: Shalya Commands
arcs.synopsis: Kripa urges peace; Shalya is made commander; Yudhishthira, the mildest of men, kills him with a spear.

compilation.title: Shalya Commands · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Shakuni's End and the Lake
arcs.synopsis: Sahadeva kills Shakuni, who began the dice; the Kaurava army is gone; Sanjaya is captured and spared. Duryodhana hides under the waters of a lake; hunters betray him; Yudhishthira offers him one duel with any of them, with any weapon, for the kingdom.

compilation.title: Shakuni's End and the Lake · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Balarama's Pilgrimage
arcs.synopsis: Balarama arrives from his pilgrimage on the Sarasvati, and the tirthas are told: the Moon's curse and his twenty-seven wives, Trita in the well, Vasishtha and Vishvamitra at the river, the old maiden who married for one night, Kurukshetra ploughed by Kuru.

compilation.title: Balarama's Pilgrimage · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Mace Duel
arcs.synopsis: Bhima and Duryodhana fight with maces; Krishna reminds Arjuna of Bhima's vow, Arjuna slaps his thigh, and Bhima breaks Duryodhana's thighs; Balarama, outraged, threatens Bhima; Duryodhana, dying, accuses Krishna; flowers fall on him; Ashvatthama is made commander of three.

compilation.title: The Mace Duel · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Night Raid
seasons.summary: Ashvatthama, Kripa and Kritavarman attack the sleeping Pandava camp: Dhrishtadyumna, Shikhandin and Draupadi's sons are killed. The Pandavas pursue Ashvatthama; his Brahmashira and Arjuna's meet, he turns his against the wombs of the Pandava women, and Krishna curses him.

arcs.title: The Owl and the Crows
arcs.synopsis: Ashvatthama watches an owl kill sleeping crows and decides; Kripa argues against it; Shiva, in a terrible form, guards the gate and then gives himself to Ashvatthama.

compilation.title: The Owl and the Crows · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Massacre
arcs.synopsis: The night slaughter; Dhrishtadyumna kicked to death; the sons of Draupadi and Shikhandin killed; the three tell the dying Duryodhana, who dies content.

compilation.title: The Massacre · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Jewel on His Brow
arcs.synopsis: Draupadi demands Ashvatthama's life; the pursuit; Ashvatthama's grass-blade Brahmashira and Arjuna's; Vyasa and Narada stand between them; Ashvatthama turns his weapon on the unborn, Krishna promises to revive Uttaraa's child and curses Ashvatthama to wander for three thousand years; Draupadi receives his jewel.

compilation.title: The Jewel on His Brow · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Women's Lament
seasons.summary: Grief after the war. Vidura consoles Dhritarashtra; the blind king crushes an iron Bhima; Gandhari's gaze burns Yudhishthira's toenail; on the battlefield Gandhari laments the dead and curses Krishna and his clan; the funeral rites, and Kunti's revelation that Karna was her son.

arcs.title: The Man in the Well and the Iron Bhima
arcs.synopsis: Vidura consoles Dhritarashtra with the parable of a man hanging in a well over a serpent, licking honey while mice gnaw the root: the human condition. The Pandavas meet the old king; Krishna substitutes an iron statue, which Dhritarashtra crushes in his embrace; Gandhari, about to curse, is calmed by Vyasa.

compilation.title: The Man in the Well and the Iron Bhima · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Gandhari's Curse
arcs.synopsis: Given sight to see the field, Gandhari walks among the dead and weeping widows, and curses Krishna: in thirty-six years his own clan will destroy itself and he will die alone in the forest. Krishna accepts. The cremations; at the river, Kunti tells her sons to offer water for Karna, her firstborn; Yudhishthira's grief.

compilation.title: Gandhari's Curse · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Bed of Arrows
seasons.summary: Yudhishthira wants to renounce the throne; his brothers, Draupadi and the sages argue him into ruling; Narada tells Karna's story. Then, by Krishna's arrangement, Bhishma on his bed of arrows teaches the duties of kings, conduct in disaster, and the way to liberation: the largest wisdom season.

arcs.title: The King Who Would Not Rule
arcs.synopsis: Narada tells Karna's life: Parashurama's curse when the insect bored his thigh and he did not move, the brahmin's curse over the cow, Indra's request. Yudhishthira wants to go to the forest; Arjuna, Bhima, the twins, Draupadi, Vyasa and Krishna argue; he curses women never to keep a secret, and is crowned in Hastinapura. Krishna, in meditation, thinks of Bhishma; Bhishma's hymn to Krishna; they go to Kurukshetra, Krishna restores Bhishma's strength, and the teaching begins.

compilation.title: The King Who Would Not Rule · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Duties of Kings I: Why Kings Exist
arcs.synopsis: Rajadharma begins: the origin of kingship (a world without a king, and Prithu), the king's protection and danda, the four orders and stages of life, a king's daily conduct.

compilation.title: The Duties of Kings I: Why Kings Exist · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Duties of Kings II: War, Counsel and Mercy
arcs.synopsis: Rajadharma continued: ministers and counsel, spies, treasury and taxes, alliances and war, the fortress, how a king treats the defeated.

compilation.title: The Duties of Kings II: War, Counsel and Mercy · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Bhishma's Fables
arcs.synopsis: The animal fables Bhishma uses to teach a king: the tiger and the virtuous jackal; the camel whose neck grew too long; the ocean and the rivers (the reed bends, the tree breaks); the hermit's dog who became a sharabha; Indra and Prahlada, and good conduct leaving a king.
arcs.reorder_note: These fables sit inside the Rajadharma teaching (12.111–124); gathered into their own side arc after it.

compilation.title: Bhishma's Fables · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Fables for Hard Times
arcs.synopsis: Apaddharma's stories: the cat and the mouse who trust each other for one night, the three fish, Vishvamitra stealing dog meat from an outcaste in a famine, the faithful dove couple and the fowler.

compilation.title: Fables for Hard Times · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Conduct in Disaster
arcs.synopsis: Apaddharma: what is right when the normal rules break down; the king in distress; danda and its mysterious nature.

compilation.title: Conduct in Disaster · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Way to Freedom I: Detachment
arcs.synopsis: Mokshadharma: Janaka's "Mithila burns, nothing of mine burns", Manki and his oxen, the brahmin Pingala, Bhrigu and Bharadvaja on creation, Jajali and the merchant Tuladhara.

compilation.title: The Way to Freedom I: Detachment · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Way to Freedom II: Samkhya, Yoga and the Narayaniya
arcs.synopsis: Mokshadharma continued: Samkhya and Yoga, Vasishtha and Karala-Janaka, Yajnavalkya, and the Narayaniya: Narada's journey to the white island to see Narayana.

compilation.title: The Way to Freedom II: Samkhya, Yoga and the Narayaniya · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Shuka
arcs.synopsis: Vyasa's son Shuka, born from a fire-stick, learns from Janaka, renounces everything and rises into the sky; Vyasa's grief and the mountains' echo.

compilation.title: Shuka · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Last Teachings
seasons.summary: Bhishma's teachings continue: on gifts, fasting, cows, the dead, and the thousand names of Vishnu, with many tales. At the sun's northward turn, Bhishma gives up his life.

arcs.title: Tales of Gift and Fate
arcs.synopsis: Gautami's son killed by a snake: the hunter, the snake, Death and Time argue who is to blame. Sudarshana who conquered death by hospitality, Vishvamitra's birth, the parrot that would not leave the dry tree, Bhangashvana who became a woman and preferred it, Ashtavakra and the North, Chyavana and Kushika.

compilation.title: Tales of Gift and Fate · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Devotion and Duty
arcs.synopsis: More tales from the Anushasana: Upamanyu's devotion to Shiva (told by Krishna); Vipula, who guards his teacher's wife Ruchi from Indra by entering her body; Nahusha and the sage Chyavana caught in a fisherman's net; King Nriga, a lizard in a well because of a cow given twice, freed by Krishna.
arcs.reorder_note: Gathered from across the Danadharma (13.14–70); the wisdom passages around them are in the next arc.

compilation.title: Devotion and Duty · The Complete Story

arcs.title: On Giving and the Thousand Names
arcs.synopsis: Danadharma: what to give, to whom and how; gifts of food, land, cows and lamps; fasts and pilgrimages; rites for ancestors; conduct and its fruits. Asked whom to worship, Bhishma recites the thousand names of Vishnu (Vishnu Sahasranama).

compilation.title: On Giving and the Thousand Names · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Bhishma's Departure
arcs.synopsis: The sun turns north; Bhishma blesses the Pandavas and Krishna, takes leave and gives up his breath by yoga; the funeral; Ganga rises from the river to mourn her son.

compilation.title: Bhishma's Departure · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Horse Sacrifice
seasons.summary: To atone, Yudhishthira performs the horse sacrifice with King Marutta's buried gold. Krishna gives Arjuna the Anugita, meets the sage Uttanka, and revives Uttaraa's stillborn son Parikshit. Arjuna follows the horse for a year and is killed and revived by his son Babhruvahana. A golden mongoose belittles the whole sacrifice.

arcs.title: Marutta's Gold
arcs.synopsis: Vyasa directs Yudhishthira to the gold left by King Marutta, whose priest Samvarta defied Brihaspati and Indra.

compilation.title: Marutta's Gold · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Anugita
arcs.synopsis: Arjuna has forgotten the Gita; Krishna teaches again through older dialogues (Kashyapa and the Siddha, the brahmin and his wife, the guru and the disciple).

compilation.title: The Anugita · The Complete Story

arcs.title: Uttanka and the Child Revived
arcs.synopsis: On his way home Krishna meets the sage Uttanka, who threatens to curse him for not preventing the war; Krishna shows his form; Uttanka's boon of water in the desert, offered by Indra in an outcaste's form. (Uttanka's earrings quest is told again with differences.) Uttaraa's son is born dead from Ashvatthama's weapon; Kunti, Subhadra and Draupadi beg Krishna; he revives the child: Parikshit, the future father of Janamejaya. The frame closes a loop.
arcs.reorder_note: An echo of episode 6: the epic's second Uttanka has a different teacher (Gautama) and a different earrings story; flag the difference on screen.

compilation.title: Uttanka and the Child Revived · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Horse's Journey
arcs.synopsis: Arjuna follows the horse for a year: the Trigartas, Bhagadatta's son, Jayadratha's grandson; at Manipura his son Babhruvahana, goaded by Ulupi, fights and kills him; Ulupi revives him with a Naga jewel.

compilation.title: The Horse's Journey · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Golden Mongoose
arcs.synopsis: The horse sacrifice; a mongoose, half its body golden, rolls in the ground and says the sacrifice is worth less than one poor brahmin family's gift of their last barley flour to a guest.

compilation.title: The Golden Mongoose · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Forest Hermitage
seasons.summary: After fifteen years, Dhritarashtra, Gandhari, Kunti, Vidura and Sanjaya retire to the forest. Vidura dies into Yudhishthira; Vyasa calls up the dead from the Ganga for one night; Dhritarashtra, Gandhari and Kunti die in a forest fire.

arcs.title: The Elders Leave
arcs.synopsis: Bhima's barbs; Dhritarashtra asks leave to go to the forest, with Gandhari; Kunti, to her sons' dismay, goes with them. The Pandavas visit the hermitage; Vidura, an ascetic skeleton, leans against a tree and passes his life into Yudhishthira.

compilation.title: The Elders Leave · The Complete Story

arcs.title: The Night of the Dead and the Forest Fire
arcs.synopsis: Vyasa calls the fallen warriors up from the Ganga for one night, free of enmity; the widows who wish it follow their husbands into the river. Narada brings news: Dhritarashtra, Gandhari and Kunti, unable to flee, died in a forest fire, sitting in meditation.

compilation.title: The Night of the Dead and the Forest Fire · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Iron Club
seasons.summary: Thirty-six years after the war, Gandhari's curse is fulfilled: the Vrishnis, drunk at Prabhasa, kill one another with reeds that turn to iron clubs. Balarama leaves his body; Krishna is shot by a hunter; Arjuna leads the survivors away and the sea swallows Dvaraka.

arcs.title: The Iron Club
arcs.synopsis: Young Vrishnis dress Samba as a pregnant woman to mock visiting sages, who curse him to give birth to an iron club that will destroy the clan; it is ground to powder and thrown into the sea. The drunken quarrel at Prabhasa: Satyaki and Kritavarman, then everyone, killing with reeds that become clubs; Balarama leaves his body as a great serpent; Krishna, sitting in the forest, is shot in the foot by the hunter Jara. Arjuna comes, grieves and leads the women away; the sea floods Dvaraka; robbers attack and the Gandiva fails him; Vyasa tells him the time of the Pandavas is over.

compilation.title: The Iron Club · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Great Journey
seasons.summary: The Pandavas crown Parikshit and set out with Draupadi and a dog toward the north. One by one they fall on the way, each for a fault Yudhishthira names; only he and the dog reach Indra's chariot, and he refuses to go to heaven without the dog.

arcs.title: The Last Journey
arcs.synopsis: The Pandavas renounce; Agni asks for the Gandiva and it goes back to the sea; the walk around the world; Draupadi, Sahadeva, Nakula, Arjuna and Bhima fall; Indra comes for Yudhishthira and says the dog cannot come; Yudhishthira refuses, and the dog becomes Dharma.

compilation.title: The Last Journey · The Complete Story

seasons.title: The Ascent
seasons.summary: In heaven Yudhishthira finds Duryodhana enthroned and his brothers apparently in hell; he chooses to stay with them; the illusion fades. All take their divine places. The frame closes: Janamejaya's sacrifice ends, and Sauti finishes his story to the sages of Naimisha.

arcs.title: Heaven, Hell and the End of the Story
arcs.synopsis: Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana in heaven and is led to a dark hell where voices of his brothers and Karna call to him; he chooses to stay; it was an illusion, a last test; he bathes in the heavenly Ganga and leaves his human body. Each hero returns to the god or power he came from (Bhishma to the Vasus, Karna to the Sun, Draupadi as Shri). Vaishampayana ends; Janamejaya's sacrifice is completed; Sauti closes the story at Naimisha with what it means to hear it.

compilation.title: Heaven, Hell and the End of the Story · The Complete Story
